Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.

About Superhuman

Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs’ collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com.

The Opportunity

Superhuman is on a mission to build the fastest, most delightful productivity experiences powered by AI. As we scale rapidly, our internal technology operations must evolve to match our ambition.

We’re looking for a Security Engineer to join our Corporate Technology team. Our commitment to user trust is unwavering, and this new team member will play a crucial role in protecting Superhuman’s corporate environment and the infrastructure that millions of users depend on. Working closely with the Corporate Infrastructure team, you will harden and secure the systems our employees rely on every day, Identity and Access Management, Endpoint Management, SaaS platforms, and Networking, while ensuring that security enables speed rather than slowing it down.

This is an opportunity to build and maintain critical security programs, including Insider Risk, Threat and Vulnerability Management, and Third-Party Risk. You’ll leverage AI to build smarter security controls and processes, and help define how AI itself is secured across our corporate infrastructure. Your work will empower employees to move fast while maintaining a high bar for corporate security.

In this role, you will:

  • Design, build, and maintain corporate security controls that enable employees to move fast with confidence, making the secure path the easiest path.

  • Develop security standards, guidelines, and policies in collaboration with the Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) team.

  • Leverage AI to build and scale security controls, automate security processes, and accelerate threat detection and response across our corporate infrastructure.

  • Define and implement AI security standards for the corporate environment, ensuring employees can safely adopt AI-powered tools and workflows.

  • Perform risk assessments and security assurance on systems that support Superhuman’s business operations: IdP, operating systems, desktop applications, SaaS solutions, and network infrastructure (ZTNA, CASB, VPN).

  • Lead the design and execution of a corporate Zero Trust architecture, working across identity, endpoint, and network security.

  • Drive the remediation of security vulnerabilities identified through assessments.

  • Evaluate and implement cutting-edge enterprise security technology to continuously strengthen our security posture.

Qualifications

  • Has 6+ years of experience working on a Security team in corporate security, enterprise security, or a related domain for a SaaS company.

  • Expert-level understanding and experience in at least two corporate security domains: Identity and Access Management, Endpoint Management, SaaS platforms, and Networking.

  • Strong experience with data protection technologies (DSPM, discovery, masking, access controls, DLP, backup).

  • Strong experience with assessing the configuration of common SaaS applications (SSPM), such as Salesforce, Workday, Coupa.

  • Strong experience with both MacOS and Windows endpoint security.

  • Familiarity with AI security principles and practical knowledge of how to secure AI adoption in a corporate environment.

  • Demonstrated experience using AI to build security controls, automate security processes, or scale security operations.

  • Ability to assess risk in ambiguous situations and make balanced security decisions that consider both offensive and defensive perspectives.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders and manage up effectively.

  • A mindset that security should enable speed, experience designing controls that protect without creating unnecessary friction.

Support for you, professionally and personally

  • Professional Growth: We believe that autonomy and trust are key to empowering our team members to do their best, most innovative work in a way that aligns with their interests, talents, and well-being

  • A connected team: Superhuman builds a product that helps people connect, and we apply this mindset to our own team. Our remote-first, hybrid model enables a highly collaborative culture rooted in our values. We work to foster belonging among team members in a variety of ways. This includes our team member resource groups, Superhuman Circles, which promote connection among those with shared identities including BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ team members, women, and parents. We also celebrate our colleagues and accomplishments with global, local, and team-specific programs.

  • Comprehensive benefits for candidates based in Germany: Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing life care (including mental health care and risk benefits) and ample and defined time off. We also offer support to set up a home office, wellness and pet care stipends, learning and development opportunities, and more.

  • Relocation Support: Superhuman provides relocation support to make your move to Berlin seamless. Our package includes visa assistance, destination services to help you and your family settle in comfortably, and a relocation bonus to cover additional expenses, such as temporary housing.

We encourage you to apply

At Superhuman, we value our differences, and we encourage all—especially those whose identities are traditionally underrepresented in tech organizations—to apply. Superhuman is an equal opportunity company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race or ethnic origin, religion or belief, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, sexual identity, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, criminal prosecution, judgment in a criminal case, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Freelance Senior Product Manager / Product Consultant (w/m/d) – Abrechnung & ERP | Remote
description: Du möchtest ein klar definiertes Produktprojekt übernehmen, komplexe Fachprozesse strukturieren und Anforderungen in konkrete Produktlösungen für eine eigens entwickelte ERP-Software übersetzen? Dann suchen wir Dich für ein freiberufliches Projektmandat als:   Freelance Product Manager (w/m/d) - Abrechnung & ERP - 3 bis 6 Monate Die Arsipa Gruppe ist eine schnell wachsende Unternehmensgruppe im Bereich Health, Safety & Environment, unterstützt von Warburg Pincus. Mit über 1.000 Mitarbeitenden, 20+ Tochtergesellschaften und 48 Standorten in Deutschland und Österreich bauen wir im Rahmen einer klaren Buy-&-Build-Strategie eine skalierbare Plattform mit nachhaltiger Wertschöpfung. Unser Ziel: eine der führenden Anbieterinnen im deutschsprachigen Markt - unterstützt durch zentrale Funktionen wie Finance, HR, Marketing und IT am Standort Berlin. Das Projekt: Für die Weiterentwicklung unserer Softwarelösung ginisuite suchen wir freiberufliche Unterstützung für ein zeitlich befristetes Produktprojekt. Der Projektstart ist zum 01.10.2026 vorgesehen. Die geplante Projektlaufzeit beträgt zunächst drei bis sechs Monate . Die ginisuite ist unsere eigens entwickelte ERP-/PVS-Lösung für Arbeitsmedizin und Arbeitssicherheit. Im Fokus des Projekts steht die fachliche und produktseitige Weiterentwicklung ausgewählter Module in den Bereichen Vertragsmanagement, Abrechnung, Zeiterfassung und Buchhaltung . Zu den Projektinhalten gehören die Analyse bestehender Fachprozesse, die Entwicklung geeigneter Lösungskonzepte sowie die Übersetzung fachlicher Anforderungen in umsetzbare User Stories und Tickets. Darüber hinaus umfasst das Mandat die fachliche Begleitung ausgewählter Themen bis zur Qualitätssicherung, Veröffentlichung, Datenmigration und Einführung. Die Zusammenarbeit erfolgt grundsätzlich remote innerhalb Deutschlands auf freiberuflicher Basis mit eigenverantwortlicher Zeiteinteilung und klar vereinbarten Projektergebnissen. Bei Bedarf können einzelne projektbezogene Termine innerhalb Deutschlands erforderlich sein, voraussichtlich etwa einmal pro Monat und nach vorheriger Abstimmung.   Dein Projektinhalte: Fachliche Konzeption und Produktentwicklung Analyse bestehender Prozesse und Systemlandschaften in den Bereichen Vertragsmanagement, Abrechnung, Zeiterfassung und Buchhaltung Identifikation und Priorisierung fachlicher Optimierungspotenziale auf Grundlage der vereinbarten Projektziele Entwicklung geeigneter Lösungsansätze und konkreter Empfehlungen für die Weiterentwicklung ausgewählter ginisuite-Module Erstellung nachvollziehbarer Fachkonzepte, User Stories, Akzeptanzkriterien und Tickets als Grundlage für die technische Umsetzung Übersetzung komplexer fachlicher Anforderungen in klare und umsetzbare Produktentscheidungen Umsetzungs- & Rolloutbegleitung Fachliche Begleitung der im Projekt vereinbarten Entwicklungspakete Vorbereitung und Durchführung fachlicher Qualitätssicherungen Projektbezogene Unterstützung bei Release-Vorbereitungen, Datenmigrationen und Rollouts Dokumentation der erarbeiteten Konzepte, Entscheidungen und Projektergebnisse Strukturierte Übergabe der vereinbarten Ergebnisse an die zuständigen Ansprechpartner:innen bei Arsipa Projektbezogene Abstimmung Selbstständige Planung und Umsetzung der eigenen Projektaktivitäten innerhalb des vereinbarten Zeitraums Projektbezogene Abstimmung mit dem Lead Product Manager, dem CTO und weiteren relevanten Ansprechpartner:innen Aufnahme fachlicher Anforderungen ausgewählter Tochtergesellschaften Fachlicher Austausch mit dem Entwicklungsteam sowie internen und externen Projektbeteiligten, beispielsweise aus dem Data-Warehouse-Umfeld Transparente Abstimmung zu Projektfortschritt, Ergebnissen, Abhängigkeiten und fachlichen Entscheidungsbedarfen Einbringung eigener methodischer Ansätze und fachlicher Empfehlungen Dein Profil: Fundierte Erfahrung als Product Manager:in, Product Owner:in, Product Consultant oder in einer vergleichbaren produktbezogenen Projektfunktion Nachweisbare Projekterfahrung in den Bereichen Rechnungswesen, ERP, Abrechnung oder vergleichbaren B2B-Softwarelösungen Erfahrung in der Analyse komplexer Fachprozesse und deren Übersetzung in konkrete Produktanforderungen Sicherer Umgang mit User Stories, Tickets, Akzeptanzkriterien und fachlichen Produktkonzepten Technisches Verständnis in den Bereichen Datenmigration, Datenanalyse und Softwareentwicklung Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse Selbstständige, strukturierte und ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise Hilfreich für das Projekt sind außerdem: Erfahrung in SaaS-, Plattform- oder ERP-nahen Projekten Kenntnisse cloudbasierter Plattformen, APIs, Integrationen oder verteilter Systeme Verständnis für Softwarearchitektur, Microservices oder containerbasierte Systemlandschaften Erfahrung im Umgang mit Legacy-Systemen und Migrationen zwischen Bestands- und Zielsystemen Projekterfahrung in Multi-Entity-, Private-Equity-, Buy-&-Build- oder vergleichbaren Wachstumsumfeldern Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Occupational Health & Safety, Arbeitsmedizin oder Arbeitssicherheit Interim-, Freelancer- oder Beratungserfahrung im Product-Management-Umfeld Rahmenbedingungen des Projekts: Freiberufliche Zusammenarbeit auf Projektbasis Projektstart zum 01.10.2026 Geplante Projektlaufzeit von zunächst drei bis sechs Monaten Voraussichtlicher Projektumfang von ca. 30 bis 40 Stunden pro Woche Remote innerhalb Deutschlands mit eigenverantwortlicher Zeiteinteilung Einzelne projektbezogene Termine innerhalb Deutschlands können bei Bedarf und nach vorheriger Abstimmung erforderlich sein Vergütung auf Basis eines individuell vereinbarten Stunden- oder Tagessatzes gegen Rechnungsstellung Zusammenarbeit auf Basis klar definierter Projektziele und Projektergebnisse, nicht im Rahmen einer Festanstellung Was Dich bei diesem Projekt erwartet: Klar definiertes Produktmandat: Ein zeitlich befristetes Projekt mit konkretem Fokus auf die Weiterentwicklung ausgewählter ERP- und Abrechnungsmodule Remote und flexible Umsetzung: Die Projektleistung kann grundsätzlich remote erbracht und zeitlich eigenverantwortlich organisiert werden Relevanter Gestaltungsspielraum: Du entwickelst eigene fachliche Lösungsansätze und bringst Deine Produkt- und title: Associate Product Owner
description: TL;DR Full-time. Berlin-based. No remote option available for this role. You sit with the PM. Join GlassDollar as an Associate Product Owner and own the space between a good idea and a shipped feature. Someone has to decide what "done" means, write it down clearly enough that an engineer can start on Monday, and stay close enough to the build that the scope does not quietly grow on the way. That is the job. You own it end to end: specs, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and a backlog that keeps everyone honest about what is actually shipping. Nobody hands you a ticket queue you did not write yourself. The problem you'll be solving A corporation with 100,000 employees has thousands of expensive operational problems, and somewhere out there a startup has already solved most of them. Getting those two facts to meet is slow, political, and mostly attempted in spreadsheets that die in someone's downloads folder. GlassDollar OS is the venture clienting platform that makes it repeatable: sourcing the startups, matching them to real problems, running the pilots, and rolling out what works across the whole organisation. Enterprise customers run real innovation budgets through it. What you scope this month decides what they can do next quarter. What we´re looking for You have personally written the tickets. 3+ years in a product company, where scoping and ticket-writing were actually your job rather than something you handed off. You are technical enough to argue with engineers. AI models, API contracts, estimates, sequencing. You push back with reasons, and you change your mind when the reasons coming back are better. You can write. A spec is a piece of writing. We will ask for a sample where the reasoning is visible, polish second. You write specs worth acting on. The valuable ones pull three threads together: where the product is going, what clients are actually telling us, and the knowledge already sitting in the team. You gather all three before you write, so what lands on the board is specific enough to build and pointed enough to matter. You know what looks good. You have a great sense of design and what feels good for users. We will ask you to build a prototype with AI and illustrate the specs visually. You have worked somewhere small enough that there was nowhere to hide. No layers between you and the consequences of a bad spec. You want to be coached hard. Direct feedback, weekly, on your actual work. You will scope alongside the product lead until you are doing it alone, and the goal is that this happens fast. You are fluent with AI tooling, day to day. We want to see the workflow, not hear it described. You want the scope to grow. The people who do best here end up owning areas outright: the major initiatives, the roadmap arguments, and the questions everyone else brings their doubts to. That is earned, and it is genuinely available. What you`ll do Your job: turn validated opportunities into work an engineer can start on Monday. Turning opportunities into scoped, sequenced, estimable work: specs, acceptance criteria, edge cases, dependencies Running the backlog: grooming, prioritisation input, keeping the board honest about what is in flight, blocked, or quietly drifting Being the interface between customer signal (support threads, CS conversations, call notes) and the engineering queue Coordinating releases and checking that what shipped matches what was scoped Presenting product decisions to varied stakeholder groups, from engineers to enterprise clients What you'll be scoping over your first year: Deep integrations into our customers' organisations. Their systems, their data, their identity stack. This is the work that turns GlassDollar from a tool people visit into infrastructure they run on. Public REST APIs and MCP servers , so our customers' engineers and their AI agents can build on top of us. AI embedded across the product , inside the surfaces people already work in. Workflow automation inside the platform , so the work that used to take six meetings and a shared spreadsheet runs itself. You will need to understand each of these well enough to write the spec and defend it in the room. This is a doing role rather than a people-management one. Mid-to-senior individual contributor. Requirements 3+ years in a product company, where you personally wrote the tickets Technical enough to understand a data model, an API contract, and estimation Demonstrable writing ability, be ready to share a spec, PRD or decision doc Nice to have: B2B enterprise SaaS background Familiarity with venture clienting, corporate innovation, or startup-scouting workflows Notion fluency Don't check every box? Apply anyway. We care more about the questions you ask about a brief than the answer you land on. How we hire Straightforward. Respectful of your time. No mystery steps. Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

Most Product Manager roles are built around specs and handoffs, waiting on a designer's mockup, an engineer's sprint slot, a data analyst's report.

This role is built differently: we're hiring a PM who does more than decide what should be built. You'll steer a developer squad end to end: investigating opportunities, analyzing user behaviour, prototyping solutions with AI, contributing code, launching experiments, and improving what reaches production.

You'll work directly with Pierre Gerbaud, Product Lead, and Michael Monin, our Co-founder & CTO, on a product already used by more than 50 million people and growing toward 100 million users.

At this scale, every small improvement can create significant impact, and you'll have the space to spot these opportunities and act on them quickly.

If your first instinct is to test an idea by making it real, this is your role.

 

Your Responsibilities

  • Own the work end to end, not just a piece of it: Understand the problem, choose an approach, build the solution (AI-assisted coding, opening pull requests, working with internal tools), launch it, measure it, and iterate with as few handoffs as possible;

  • Build with AI every day: Use AI tools for research, analysis, prototyping, and debugging; as a genuine part of how you think and work, evolving with the tools as they improve;

  • Decide what's worth pursuing, and test it fast: When a dozen directions look plausible and there are more ideas than time, identify the opportunities that matter most and design the smallest meaningful experiment to test your assumptions;

  • Let the results determine what happens next: Define success before you build, analyse the outcome once the experiment is live, and use what you learn to improve, expand, or stop what you shipped;

  • Work embedded in a software engineering squad: partner directly with Leads, Co-founders, designers, and engineers to define and deliver priority projects, and communicate progress and decisions to all relevant stakeholders;

  • Keep momentum high: Surface blockers the moment they appear, challenge assumptions directly regardless of who made them, and find another route forward when the obvious one is blocked;

 

Your Qualifications

  • You use data to make product decisions: you can name the metrics you want to influence, explain why it matters, and say whether your work actually moved them. You’ve run A/B tests, product experiments, data deep-dives, or lightweight user research and used the findings to shape what was built next;

  • You explore AI independently: you actively seek out and experiment with new tools and techniques without waiting for a project or manager to require them;

  • You take ownership and move without waiting for certainty: comfortable with ambiguity, you create clarity by investigating, building, testing, and learning rather than waiting for a complete brief. You balance execution against planning, address blockers early, and take responsibility for the outcome rather than waiting to be told what to do, caring more about reaching the right result than following a fixed process;

  • You care about the user experience: you take pride in the quality of what reaches users, and pay attention to whether the product is useful, intuitive, and engaging;

Bonus points

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

You won't inherit a finished SRE practice: you'll help define it, side by side with our Berlin development teams – and you won't do it alone, a Team Lead SRE hire is coming next. SRE here is an enabling discipline: you build what our developers need to ship reliably, while two system administrators in Pforzheim run the physical hardware. And the impact is direct – our product discovery technology powers more than 2,000 European online shops (Intersport, SPAR, Douglas and more), handling billions of shopper queries a year. When product discovery is slow or down, our customers lose revenue in real time. Your first 90 days You get to know both products, join the on-call rotation with a buddy, and own your first reliability topic – SLOs for one product, alerting that actually helps at 3 a.m., or automating away a piece of toil. By day 90 you've shipped visible improvements and know where you want to take the platform next. Your mission Define and own SLOs, SLIs and error budgets; drive data-informed reliability decisions Lead incident response end-to-end: fast detection, clear communication, blameless postmortems – and reduce whole classes of incidents structurally, not case by case Eliminate toil through automation and GitOps; evolve our observability (metrics, logs, traces, alerting, runbooks) across two different stacks Help build our custom Kubernetes operator (CRDs) that makes stateful search clusters declarative, self-healing and safely upgradable – and roll out the auto-scaling (HPA/VPA, KEDA, cluster auto scaler) today's architecture makes hard Plan capacity, performance and cost across on-premises and cloud – including the large-catalogue and peak-season loads our merchants care about – and use AI tools wherever they measurably speed up diagnosis and operations Your profile Must-haves: Kubernetes in production – built, not just used : you've set up and maintained clusters on your own servers (e.g. kubeadm , RKE2, k3s) and know cluster lifecycle and upgrades – managed-only experience isn't enough for this role Lived SRE practice : SLOs, error budgets, incident management, on-call Hands-on experience with GitOps or comparable infrastructure/deployment automation – experience with Argo CD or Flux is a strong plus Solid observability skills – metrics, logs, traces, alerting that people trust A strong automation instinct – you'd rather fix a problem's cause than repeat its workaround A collaborative, enabling mindset – you see SRE as a service to our developers: you ask what they need, discuss trade-offs openly, and don't fall in love with your own solution Nice-to-haves (genuinely optional – we'll teach you the rest): Harvester, KubeVirt , vSphere/ ESXi , OpenStack or similar virtualization/HCI platforms Container storage (Longhorn, Ceph) and datacenter networking (load balancing, ingress, VLAN) Auto-scaling (HPA, VPA, KEDA, cluster auto scaler ) and capacity/cost planning Experience building Kubernetes operators/CRDs German language skills Certifications (CKA, CKS) are welcome but no substitute for hands-on experience – in the tech interview we'll ask about what you've actually built and operated.   • Tech stack: Kubernetes on our own servers, Harvester (KubeVirt), Argo CD/Flux, Prometheus/Grafana, Longhorn/Ceph
  • Team: A growing SRE team – you report to our CTPO for now and to the Team Lead SRE we're hiring next; two system administrators in Pforzheim run the physical hardware
  • Process: Intro call · take-home task (~2h) · 90-min tech interview with our developers · leadership conversation · meet the team
  • Languages: Fluent English required; German is a plus, not a must

Why this role is special 

Most SRE jobs today mean clicking around a managed cloud console. This one doesn't. We run our own hardware in Frankfurt and are building a modern private cloud platform on Kubernetes and Harvester – on-prem by default, with elastic burst into the public cloud and the option to go cloud-only later. You won't inherit a finished SRE practice: you'll help define it, side by side with our Berlin development teams – and you won't do it alone, a Team Lead SRE hire is coming next. 

SRE here is an enabling discipline: you build what our developers need to ship reliably, while two system administrators in Pforzheim run the physical hardware. And the impact is direct – our product discovery technology powers more than 2,000 European online shops (Intersport, SPAR, Douglas and more), handling billions of shopper queries a year. When product discovery is slow or down, our customers lose revenue in real time. 

Your first 90 days 

You get to know both products, join the on-call rotation with a buddy, and own your first reliability topic – SLOs for one product, alerting that actually helps at 3 a.m., or automating away a piece of toil. By day 90 you've shipped visible improvements and know where you want to take the platform next.


Your mission

  • Define and own SLOs, SLIs and error budgets; drive data-informed reliability decisions
  • Lead incident response end-to-end: fast detection, clear communication, blameless postmortems – and reduce whole classes of incidents structurally, not case by case
  • Eliminate toil through automation and GitOps; evolve our observability (metrics, logs, traces, alerting, runbooks) across two different stacks
  • Help build our custom Kubernetes operator (CRDs) that makes stateful search clusters declarative, self-healing and safely upgradable – and roll out the auto-scaling (HPA/VPA, KEDA, cluster auto scaler) today's architecture makes hard
  • Plan capacity, performance  and cost across on-premises and cloud – including the large-catalogue and peak-season loads our merchants care about – and use AI tools wherever they measurably speed up diagnosis and operations


Your profile

Must-haves: 

  • Kubernetes in production – built, not just used: you've set up and maintained clusters on your own servers (e.g. kubeadm, RKE2, k3s) and know cluster lifecycle and upgrades – managed-only experience isn't enough for this role
  • Lived SRE practice: SLOs, error budgets, incident management, on-call
  • Hands-on experience with GitOpsor comparable infrastructure/deployment automation – experience with Argo CD or Flux is a strong plus
  • Solid observability skills – metrics, logs, traces, alerting that people trust
  • A strong automation instinct – you'd rather fix a problem's cause than repeat its workaround
  • A collaborative, enabling mindset – you see SRE as a service to our developers: you ask what they need, discuss trade-offs openly, and don't fall in love with your own solution
Nice-to-haves (genuinely optional – we'll teach you the rest): 
  • Harvester, KubeVirt, vSphere/ESXi, OpenStack or similar virtualization/HCI platforms
  • Container storage (Longhorn, Ceph) and datacenter networking (load balancing, ingress, VLAN)
  • Auto-scaling (HPA, VPA, KEDA, cluster auto scaler) and capacity/cost planning
  • Experience building Kubernetes operators/CRDs
  • German language skills
Certifications (CKA, CKS) are welcome but no substitute for hands-on experience – in the tech interview we'll ask about what you've actually built and operated. 

You don't tick every box – or your title was never “SRE”? Apply anyway. If you've owned production systems, handled incidents and worked deeply with Kubernetes, we want to hear from you – production experience and engineering mindset matter more to us than titles or buzzwords.


THE JOY OF WORKING WITH US

  • Impact from day one: Your work directly influences the revenue of leading eCommerce brands across Europe.
  • Modern tech stack: Kubernetes, Harvester, GitOps, auto-scaling, and an exciting path toward the cloud – with room to build things right.
  • AI-first mindset: We use AI as a real part of our daily work, not as a buzzword.
  • Ownership & growth: Clear responsibility, short decision paths, and the opportunity to actively shape your role.
  • Flexible work: Hybrid work model three office days per week with a focus on outcomes.
  • Strong team: Experienced engineers, an open feedback culture, and an environment where reliability is treated as a real engineering discipline.

  • Übernahme der fachlichen Verantwortung für die Betreuung und Entwicklung von Demonstratoren für unser Business Development sowie deren Überführung in stabile, performante und langfristig betreibbare Produktionsumgebungen
  • Übernahme der Leitung oder Mitarbeit an Projekten mit Schwerpunkt auf technischem Steering, mit besonderem Augenmerk auf Qualitätssicherung in den Bereichen Data Science und Prompt Engineering

  • Konzeption und Umsetzung interner Schulungen, um das Wissen im Team zu vertiefen und die kontinuierliche Weiterbildung im Unternehmen zu fördern

  • Aktive Teilnahme an relevanten Konferenzen sowie das Halten von Vorträgen, um erlangtes Wissen zu teilen und als Expert:in und Repräsentant:in des Unternehmens aufzutreten

  • Idealerweise Erfahrung in probabilistic modeling, Text Processing & NLP, Transformer-Architekturen, Conversational AI, Stable Diffusion, Hardware Accelerators, Physical Computing sowie im Betrieb und Finetuning lokaler (Open-Source-)Foundation-Modelle

Vertrauensarbeitszeit mit flexibler Arbeitszeitgestaltung - ob voll remote oder in einem unserer modern eingerichteten Innenstadtbüros (inkl. Dachterrasse), workation - nutze die Möglichkeit aus dem EU-Ausland zu arbeiten
Kultur & Zusammenarbeit
Einzigartige Teamatmosphäre, flache Hierarchien zu unserem CEO Alex sowie eine offene Feedbackkultur, jährliche Teamworkshops auf unserem Data.Castle im Zillertal, gelebtes Data.Musketeer Prinzip – „einer für alle, alle für einen!“, unser [at] Buddy Programm zur besseren Vernetzung, regelmäßig stattfindende Fach- und Freizeitevents, hundefreundliche Büros

description: <h2 data-path-to-node="2">Über uns: Wer/Was ist Artefact?</h2> <p data-path-to-node="3">Artefact ist eine weltweit führende Beratung für Daten- und KI-Dienstleistungen mit Hauptsitz in Paris. Mit mehr als 2.000 Consultants, Data Scientists und Engineers in 26 Ländern arbeiten wir mit den globalen Marktführern zusammen. An unseren deutschen Standorten befinden wir uns auf einem rasanten Wachstumskurs. Wir beraten führende nationale und internationale Kunden branchenübergreifend dabei, das volle Potenzial ihrer Daten auszuschöpfen, skalierbare Datenarchitekturen aufzubauen und innovative KI-Lösungen zu implementieren.</p> <p data-path-to-node="4">Als <strong data-path-to-node="4" data-index-in-node="4">Senior Consultant (m/w/d) Data &amp; AI Strategy</strong> stehst du im Mittelpunkt dieser Mission. Dabei begleitest du unsere Kunden von fokussierten Kurzzeit-Projekten im gehobenen Mittelstand bis hin zu mehrphasigen KI-Transformationen in Großkonzernen. In dieser Rolle übernimmst du die Verantwortung für crossfunktionale Workstreams, treibst datenbasierte Entscheidungen voran und gestaltest die digitale Zukunft unserer Kunden aktiv mit.</p> <p data-path-to-node="4">&nbsp;</p> <h2 data-path-to-node="6">Das erwartet dich bei uns:</h2> <ul> <li data-path-to-node="7,0,0"><strong data-path-to-node="7,0,0" data-index-in-node="0">Kundenberatung &amp; Strategie:</strong> Du arbeitest eng mit (internationalen) Kunden zusammen, verstehst deren geschäftliche Anforderungen und übersetzt diese in datengestützte Empfehlungen, die strategische Entscheidungen und die Business Transformation unterstützen.</li> <li data-path-to-node="7,1,0"><strong data-path-to-node="7,1,0" data-index-in-node="0">Daten &amp; Analyse:</strong> Du sammelst, strukturierst und bereitest Daten für Analysen auf. Dabei arbeitest du kollaborativ in interdisziplinären Teams aus den Bereichen Consulting, Data und Tech.</li> <li data-path-to-node="7,3,0"><strong data-path-to-node="7,3,0" data-index-in-node="0">Daten- &amp; KI-Lösungen:</strong> Du unterstützt die Entwicklung von Datenstrategien, KI-Use-Cases sowie Business-Intelligence-Lösungen und wirkst bei Governance-Frameworks und Implementierungs-Roadmaps mit.</li> <li data-path-to-node="7,4,0"><strong data-path-to-node="7,4,0" data-index-in-node="0">Wissenstransfer &amp; Kollaboration:</strong> Du trägst zu einer starken Teamkultur bei, indem du dein Wissen teilst, dich über digitale Trends und KI-Entwicklungen auf dem Laufenden hältst und die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung des Teams unterstützt.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2 data-path-to-node="9">Das bringst du mit:</h2> <p data-path-to-node="10">Im Kern definieren wir uns über eine Kultur der Eigenverantwortung, der intellektuellen Neugier und der Zusammenarbeit. Konzepte wie Generative KI, LLMs oder Predictive Analytics sind dir vertraut und du brennst darauf, die Lücke zwischen Business-Anforderungen und KI-Einsatz zu schließen. Idealerweise hast du bereits Erfahrung in der Konzeption von KI-Use-Cases oder im Data-Platform-Tracking.</li> <li data-path-to-node="11,2,0"><strong data-path-to-node="11,2,0" data-index-in-node="0">Business-Orientierung &amp; analytisches Denken:</strong> Du verbindest ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten mit einer geschäftsorientierten Denkweise. Es macht dir Spaß, geschäftliche Herausforderungen zu identifizieren und sie in praktische, KI- und datengestützte Lösungen zu übersetzen.</li> <li data-path-to-node="11,3,0"><strong data-path-to-node="11,3,0" data-index-in-node="0">Technische Fähigkeiten:</strong> Du bist sicher im Umgang mit Excel und PowerPoint. B. als Übersetzer der Anforderungen zwischen Business-Stakeholdern und Data Scientists).</li> <li data-path-to-node="11,5,0"><strong data-path-to-node="11,5,0" data-index-in-node="0">Persönlichkeit:</strong> Du agierst proaktiv, strukturiert sowie lösungsorientiert und zeichnest dich durch eine ausgeprägte Kunden- und Stakeholder-Orientierung aus. Du blühst in dynamischen Umfeldern auf und hast Freude daran, komplexe Probleme zu lösen.</li> <li data-path-to-node="11,5,0"><strong>Sprachkenntnisse:</strong> Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sind eine Grundvoraussetzung. Weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.</li> <li data-path-to-node="11,7,0"><strong data-path-to-node="11,7,0" data-index-in-node="0">Arbeitserlaubnis:</strong> Eine gültige Arbeitserlaubnis für Deutschland.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2 data-path-to-node="13">Warum ARTEFACT?</h2> <ul> <li data-path-to-node="14,0,0"><strong data-path-to-node="14,0,0" data-index-in-node="0">Einflussreiche Kundenprojekte:</strong> Arbeite an anspruchsvollen Projekten mit führenden nationalen und internationalen Kunden in den Bereichen Daten, Digitalisierung und zukunftsweisende Datenstrategie.</li> <li data-path-to-node="14,1,0"><strong data-path-to-node="14,1,0" data-index-in-node="0">Karriere- und Entwicklungschancen:</strong> Wir glauben an Leistung, nicht an Dienstalter. Dein Aufstieg wird durch deinen Impact bestimmt, nicht durch deine Betriebszugehörigkeit - mit klaren Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten und vielfältigen Karriereperspektiven.</li> <li data-path-to-node="14,2,0"><strong data-path-to-node="14,2,0" data-index-in-node="0">Attraktive Vergütung:</strong> Ein starkes Vergütungspaket inklusive eines leistungsabhängigen Bonus, der halbjährlich ausgezahlt wird.</li> <li data-path-to-node="14,3,0"><strong data-path-to-node="14,3,0" data-index-in-node="0">Lernen &amp; Weiterentwicklung:</strong> Werde Teil eines Teams aus passionierten Data Consultants, die sich gegenseitig aktiv unterstützen. description: <h2><strong>Kurz und knapp</strong></h2> <p>Als Online-Supermarkt ist das Herzstück unseres Businesses natürlich die Picnic App. Das Category Management Team sorgt dafür, dass unsere digitalen Regale in&nbsp;<strong>allen 6 Regionen</strong> perfekt mit lokalen Produkten ausgestattet sind.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Als WerkstudentIn bist du das operative Rückgrat unseres Teams. Mit&nbsp;<strong>logischem Denken</strong> und smarten Automatisierungstools machst du unsere Prozesse jeden Tag ein Stückchen besser. Du arbeitest eng mit Category, Brand und <strong>cross-funktionalen Teams zusammen</strong>, um Lieferengpässe zu lösen, Daten zu checken und dafür zu sorgen, dass unsere App für die KundInnen immer perfekt gepflegt ist.</p> <h2><strong>Das erwartet dich</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Artikelerstellung &amp; Onboarding:</strong> Du übernimmst die Anlage und Erstellung neuer Produkte im System und stellst sicher, dass alle notwendigen Informationen vom ersten Tag an korrekt und für unsere KundInnen bereit sind.</li> <li><strong>Tool-Support &amp; Validierung:</strong> Du begleitest die Einführung und Nutzung unseres neuen Automatisierungstools. Als wichtige Instanz für die Qualitätskontrolle hinterfragst du Prozesse kritisch und stellst sicher, dass die Systemausgaben korrekt sind.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Produkt-Performance-Monitoring:</strong> Du behältst Verkaufs- und Bestandsanomalien genau im Auge. Wenn ein Top-Priority-Artikel sich nicht verkauft oder als nicht verfügbar angezeigt wird, tauchst du ins System ein, um die Ursache zu finden, damit unsere digitalen Regale immer den maximalen Umsatz erzielen.</li> <li><strong>Content- &amp; Storefront-Optimierung:</strong> Wenn unvollständige Produktpräsentationen den Verkauf hemmen, reagierst du schnell und taktisch – z. B. durch das schnelle Beheben von fehlenden Produktfotos oder unvollständigen Artikelinfos in der App.</li> <li><strong>Lieferkette &amp; Inbound-Abstimmung:</strong> Du unterstützt das Team bei täglichen kommerziellen Fragen zur Lieferkette und klärst Probleme bei der Produktanlieferung, um einen reibungslosen Ablauf in deinen Kategorien zu garantieren.</li> <li><strong>Teamarbeit:</strong> Du bietest starke operative Unterstützung über verschiedene Prioritätsstufen hinweg und arbeitest Hand in Hand mit dem gesamten Category-Team, um die täglichen Aufgaben optimal zu balancieren.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Das bringst du mit</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Fortgeschrittenes Bachelorstudium oder aktuell im Master in Betriebswirtschaftslehre, E-Commerce, Supply Chain Management, Volkswirtschaftslehre oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang.</li> <li>Ein scharfes Auge fürs Detail, starkes logisches Denkvermögen und eine natürliche Neugier, um hinter die Kulissen zu blicken und operative Rätsel zu lösen.</li> <li>Exzellente organisatorische Fähigkeiten, eine proaktive Einstellung zur Übernahme von Verantwortung und Routine im Umgang mit täglichen Arbeitsabläufen.</li> <li>Eine echte Affinität für die Lebensmittelbranche und Begeisterung für die Arbeit mit neuer Software Systemen.</li> <li>Zeit, unser Team für <strong>16 - 20 Stunden</strong> pro Woche zu unterstützen.</li> <li style="font-weight: bold;"><strong>Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.</strong></li> </ul> <h2><strong>Darauf kannst du dich freuen</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Starte mit uns durch: </strong>Werde Teil unseres internationalen Teams in einem Umfeld, das echtes Wachstum und eine „Act like an Owner“-Mentalität fördert. Bei uns hast du die Chance, Projekte eigenverantwortlich voranzutreiben, neue Ideen zu testen und direkt miterleben zu können, wie deine Arbeit in unserem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen Wirkung zeigt.</li> <li><strong>Verpflegung: </strong>Genieße jeden Tag ein frisches, kostenloses Frühstück und Mittagessen in unserem Büro, dazu gibt es reichlich Snacks und Obst für den Energiekick zwischendurch.</li> <li><strong>Unvergessliche Momente:</strong> Von unserem legendären jährlichen Ski-Trip über Weihnachtsfeiern bis hin zu Auftritten unserer eigenen Picnic-Band: Wir feiern unsere Erfolge gemeinsam.</li> <li><strong>Ein moderner Workspace:</strong> Unser neu renoviertes Büro ist auf Zusammenarbeit ausgelegt und bietet dir flexible Arbeitszeiten sowie 30 Urlaubstage (bei einer 40-Stunden-Woche).</li> <li><strong>Wohlbefinden &amp; Gleichgewicht:</strong> Wir bieten dir professionelle Unterstützung für deine mentale Gesundheit mit OpenUp. Und dank unseres hundefreundlichen Büros ist dein vierbeiniger Begleiter nach Absprache willkommen.</li> <li><strong>Die Basics:</strong> Wir stellen dir alles für deinen Erfolg bereit - inklusive Laptop sowie Zugang zu exklusiven Rabatten (Corporate Benefits) für Reisen, Technik und vieles mehr.</li> <li><strong>Nachhaltigkeit als Kern:</strong> Werde Teil der Revolution. Du trägst zu einer grüneren Zukunft bei – durch unsere 100 % elektrische Flotte und unsere Lieferkette, die Lebensmittelverschwendung reduziert.</li> <li><strong>Attraktive Vergütung:</strong> Als WerkstudentIn verdienst du 14,75 €/Std. (Bachelor) bzw. 15,50 €/Std. (Master) und sammelst spannende Praxiserfahrung.</li> </ul> <p>Schick uns deine Bewerbung gern auf Englisch, wenn du schon eine englische Version parat hast.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Analytics - Future Leaders Graduate Program
description: <h2>&nbsp;</h2> <h2><strong>Real ownership. Real impact. Build from day one.</strong></h2> <p>Are you an ambitious graduate ready to tackle complex<strong>,</strong> real-world challenges at the intersection of data, strategy and tech?&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The Future Leaders Graduate Program – Business Analytics</strong> at Picnic is a one-year launchpad for exceptional talents. From day one, you join a business team, own a business topic, and become an expert in your field.</p> <p>At Picnic, we’re building the future of grocery. Using cutting-edge technology and data-driven innovation, we challenge the status quo and build the world’s smartest, most customer-focused supermarket. <br>We move fast, think big, and turn bold ideas into tangible impact.</p> <h2><strong>Tricks of the trade</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Lead with ambition</strong>: Bring your relentless determination, creativity, and grit. Take the driver’s seat and redefine the grocery shopping experience for millions. You will be expected to think independently, move fast, and deliver results.</li> <li><strong>Steep learning curve</strong>: Your growth comes from owning real problems, testing your ideas, learning from your mistakes and starting again. You'll blend hands-on training with immediate execution, you’ll move at a pace that accelerates your growth like nowhere else.</li> <li><strong>Solve real-life puzzles</strong>: Spot opportunities, use tools at the forefront of technology, and own the outcome end to end. Not just making slides, but building the solution yourself.</li> <li><strong>Innovate across borders</strong>: You’ll collaborate with teams across the Netherlands, Germany, and France, tackling challenges that redefine how Picnic operates at a European scale.</li> <li><strong>High-performance environment</strong>: You’ll work alongside some of the best teams in analytics and tech, people who set a high bar and expect you to do the same.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>From learning to leading</strong></h2> <p>Throughout this one-year program, you’ll own business-critical projects from start to finish right from the get-go, supported by mentorship, learning sessions, and regular feedback.</p> <p>You’ll strengthen your leadership skills in project management, storytelling, stakeholder communication, and giving and receiving feedback, while sharpening your technical skills in Python, SQL, Excel, and PowerPoint.</p> <p>As your scope grows, so does your responsibility. You might scale your initial project or take on new challenges within the same domain. Either way, there’s always a new challenge to lead and an opportunity to make an impact. That’s why every journey is unique: there’s no standardized path through the program, just continuous opportunities to grow and lead.</p> <h3><strong>Where you’ll make an impact</strong></h3> <p>From day one, you’ll be embedded in a business team, taking ownership in one of the following domains:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Consumer</strong> - Drive growth through pricing, supplier strategy, and our market strategy. Think: Shaping our successful market entry into new cities. Your decisions shape how millions of customers experience Picnic.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Logistics </strong>- Build the backbone of Picnics operations. Think: robotic fulfilment, demand forecasting, route optimization across Europe and much more</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Your superpowers</strong></h2> <p>You don't wait for permission. title: Praktikant (all genders) 3-6 Monate im Bereich Consumer Promotions
description: Einleitung Du hast auf der Webseite viel über die Belohnung von Mitarbeitern gelesen? Dann werden wir dich nun überraschen: In unserer Abteilung geht es um die Belohnung von klassischen Endkunden, das könntest z.B. auch du sein. Das heißt, wir arbeiten mit bekannten Unternehmen zusammen, die ihre Endkunden zum Beispiel für den Kauf eines bestimmten Produkts, das Erreichen eines Warenkorbs oder den Abschluss eines Vertrags mit einem Gutschein motivieren und belohnen möchten. Bestimmt hast du unsere Kampagnen sogar schon im Handel gesehen oder bist selbst dabei, wenn die nächste große Aktion startet und du Freunden und Familie live zeigen kannst, woran du arbeitest. Bitte beachte: Wir besetzen diese Praktikumsstelle aktuell ab Mitte Januar 2027 – Bewerbungen nehmen wir aber schon jetzt gerne entgegen! Deine Aufgaben Du bekommst direkt von Beginn an wertvolles Marketing- und Branchen-Know-how vermittelt, erhältst deine eigenen Projekte und bist so ab deinem ersten Tag ein vollwertiges Teammitglied für uns Du arbeitest aktiv an spannenden Marketing-Konzepten und -Kampagnen für Kunden aus verschiedenen Branchen (z.B. Consumer Electronics, Lebensmittel, Kosmetik) mit und trägst maßgeblich zu deren Erfolg bei Du arbeitest an der Weiterentwicklung unserer Produkte, sowie an der Einführung neuer Produkte und leistest damit deinen wertvollen Beitrag zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unserer Konzepte Neben dem Kampagnen- und Produktmanagement warten weitere spannende Projekte darauf, von dir übernommen zu werden. Eine eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise ist für uns dabei selbstverständlich Du hast die Möglichkeit, mit unserem Vertrieb an Kundenterminen teilzunehmen. raw.title: Praktikant (all genders) 3-6 Monate im Bereich Consumer Promotions
raw.description:
Einleitung

Du hast auf der Webseite viel über die Belohnung von Mitarbeitern gelesen? Dann werden wir dich nun überraschen: In unserer Abteilung geht es um die Belohnung von klassischen Endkunden, das könntest z.B. auch du sein. Das heißt, wir arbeiten mit bekannten Unternehmen zusammen, die ihre Endkunden zum Beispiel für den Kauf eines bestimmten Produkts, das Erreichen eines Warenkorbs oder den Abschluss eines Vertrags mit einem Gutschein motivieren und belohnen möchten. Bestimmt hast du unsere Kampagnen sogar schon im Handel gesehen oder bist selbst dabei, wenn die nächste große Aktion startet und du Freunden und Familie live zeigen kannst, woran du arbeitest.

Bitte beachte: Wir besetzen diese Praktikumsstelle aktuell ab Mitte Januar 2027 – Bewerbungen nehmen wir aber schon jetzt gerne entgegen!


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du bekommst direkt von Beginn an wertvolles Marketing- und Branchen-Know-how vermittelt, erhältst deine eigenen Projekte und bist so ab deinem ersten Tag ein vollwertiges Teammitglied für uns
  • Du arbeitest aktiv an spannenden Marketing-Konzepten und -Kampagnen für Kunden aus verschiedenen Branchen (z.B. Consumer Electronics, Lebensmittel, Kosmetik) mit und trägst maßgeblich zu deren Erfolg bei
  • Du arbeitest an der Weiterentwicklung unserer Produkte, sowie an der Einführung neuer Produkte und leistest damit deinen wertvollen Beitrag zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unserer Konzepte
  • Neben dem Kampagnen- und Produktmanagement warten weitere spannende Projekte darauf, von dir übernommen zu werden. Eine eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise ist für uns dabei selbstverständlich
  • Du hast die Möglichkeit, mit unserem Vertrieb an Kundenterminen teilzunehmen. So erlebst du live mit, wie das von dir erstellte Konzept beim Kunden für Begeisterung sorgt
  • Dich erwartet ein kreatives Team, das nicht nur gerne zusammenarbeitet, sondern sich auch neben den täglichen To Dos gerne zum gemeinsamen Mittagessen verabredet. Ein gutes Betriebsklima und Spaß an der Arbeit sind deshalb definitiv vorprogrammiert!


Dein Profil

  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit den gängigen MS Office Programmen (Power Point, Word, Excel und Outlook)
  • Du besitzt eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe und Organisationstalent
  • Du bist kreativ, teamfähig und arbeitest eigenständig
  • Du kannst sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse vorweisen

  • Vielfältige Einblicke: Du lernst verschiedene Unternehmensbereiche kennen – passend zu deinen Interessen und Stärken

title: Product Owner (all genders)
description: Deine Rolle bei uns Digitalisierung ist kein Buzzword, sondern eine Haltung. In deiner Rolle als Product Owner (all genders) gestaltest du digitale Produkte, Prozesse und Lösungen, die echten Nutzen schaffen – für Anwender:innen, Organisationen und anspruchsvolle Projekte. Du verantwortest die Produktvision, übersetzt Anforderungen in umsetzbare Lösungen und bringst Fachbereiche, IT, Stakeholder:innen und externe Partner:innen an einen Tisch. Dabei denkst du nicht nur agil oder klassisch – sondern situativ das, was wirklich funktioniert. Welche Aufgaben auf dich warten Digitale Lösungen gestalten & weiterentwickeln Du entwickelst Ideen und Zielbilder für digitale Produkte, Prozesse und Lösungen. raw.description:
What we do

At Briink, we’re building AI technology for the global sustainability economy. We work with the world’s largest climate organizations, including CDP and PRI, and multinational companies such as Bayer, Siemens, Commerzbank, E.ON, and Heidelberg Materials.

Our technology helps automate how sustainability data is collected, analyzed, verified, and acted on. Through our work with global climate organizations, what you build at Briink will directly impact the sustainability workflows of more than 30,000 companies, investors, and cities worldwide.

We’re a small team working at enormous scale. Your code won’t sit behind an internal tool or an experimental demo — it will help shape how some of the world’s largest organizations understand and act on their environmental impact. Based at Berlin’s AI Campus, with a second office in London, and backed by over €7 million in funding, we want to prove that some of the world’s most powerful technology can also be a powerful force for good.

Application requirement: Intro video
As part of your application, please submit a short intro video (max 2 minutes) answering:

  1. Who you are and what you have done/built that is relevant for this role. 
  2. Why you’re excited about owning and shipping AI-powered products at Briink. 
  3. Why Briink’s sustainability mission resonates with you.
Upload your video using this form (YouTube unlisted, Loom, or any other solution is fine). We do this to get a better sense of candidates before continuing the process. Any application without a video will not be considered ;)


Your role

As Briink’s Backend/AI Product Engineer, you’ll join a small, high-ownership product and engineering team building AI-powered products for sustainability professionals.

This is not a narrowly scoped backend role. You’ll take meaningful product problems from initial discovery and user conversations through technical design, implementation, and iteration to deploy them at scale across the ESG market. You’ll combine strong backend and AI/LLM engineering with product judgement and the initiative to work out what should be built - not just how to action a predefined ticket.

You will:

  • Own product features end to end, from understanding the user problem and defining the right approach through to delivery, measurement, and improvement.
  • Design and build scalable backend systems, including APIs, data models, workflows, and infrastructure for complex enterprise products.
  • Build and ship applied AI/LLM features, such as LLM chains, RAG systems, tool-using agents, structured-output pipelines, and evaluation workflows
  • Create reusable, extensible platform building blocks that support multiple user journeys and reporting workflows rather than solving each problem in isolation.
  • Improve the robustness of our systems, strengthening reliability, testing, observability, performance, and maintainability as we scale.
  • Work directly with users, product, and data, using qualitative feedback and product data to understand the real problem and evaluate whether a solution works.
  • Prototype and test new AI capabilities, turning promising ideas into practical product improvements that accelerate our roadmap.
  • Bring thoughtful opinions and constructive challenge, helping the team make better product and technical decisions.
  • Collaborate closely with other engineers, including through pair programming, technical design discussions, and shared problem-solving.


Your profile

Technical requirements

  • Strong professional backend engineering experience, with a track record of designing and shipping reliable production systems.
  • Experience in a small, high-ownership product team, ideally within a startup or scale-up engineering organisation of roughly 5–20 engineers.
  • Evidence that you have shipped meaningful products end to end, rather than owning only a narrow component within a much larger organisation.
  • Strong experience in Python (or another modern backend language such as Java, Ruby, or TypeScript, combined with the ability and willingness to become productive in Python quickly).
  • Strong API, database, and systems design skills, with the ability to model complex workflows and build maintainable foundations for enterprise products.
  • Applied AI/LLM experience: you have experience or a strong interest in LLM-powered features, ideally involving RAG or retrieval, tool use, agents, structured outputs, or evaluation systems.
  • A solid software-quality mindset, including testing, code review, CI/CD, observability, and pragmatic approaches to reliability and security.
  • Cloud and container experience, with an understanding of how to deploy, operate, and scale production workloads.
  • Fluent English (C1+), both written and spoken. 
Nice to have
  • Experience building workflow, reporting, questionnaire, or other complex B2B SaaS products.
  • Familiarity with backend technologies such as FastAPI, PostgreSQL, background queues 
  • Any experience with LangChain, LangSmith, or other LLM frameworks
  • Deeper experience with RAG, retrieval, agents, LLM evaluation, and production AI systems.
  • Experience improving latency, cost, and reliability for AI workloads.
  • Knowledge of ESG, sustainability, climate tech, or corporate reporting.
  • German language skills.
Who you are
  • Kind and collaborative: You treat people well, communicate clearly, and help create a supportive, low-ego team environment.
  • Mission-driven: You care about using technology to accelerate sustainability and climate action.
  • Sharp and curious: You learn quickly, ask good questions, and enjoy getting to the root of difficult product and technical problems.
  • A product-minded builder: You think beyond the task in front of you, focus on the user’s real problem, and care about whether what you ship creates value.
  • Highly self-directed: You thrive in a fast-moving environment with autonomy, ambiguity, and limited oversight.
  • Pragmatic and action-oriented: You can move from ideas to experiments to production without waiting for perfect requirements.
  • Opinionated but open-minded: You challenge ideas constructively, welcome pushback, and enjoy thinking through problems with others.
  • Commercially aware and creative: You balance technical quality with user needs, business value, and speed.
If your experience doesn’t align precisely with all the criteria, don't worry! We encourage you to still apply. Many people miss out on opportunities because they feel they don’t fit every requirement—we believe in attitude, growth and iteration, not perfection!


What we offer

  • Competitive salary and equity, reflecting your impact and ownership.
  • Purpose-driven mission: Build tools that help organisations act more sustainably and make the ESG data ecosystem more transparent.
  • Flexible hybrid setup: Berlin or London based candidates are strongly preferred, with access to our team and the wider startup community at the Merantix AI Campus.
  • Trust and autonomy: Own meaningful problems, shape the product, and influence how we build as the company grows.
  • A genuinely high-impact role: Increase our delivery capacity, strengthen the robustness of our platform, and accelerate product innovation.
  • Dynamic environment: Work in a small, ambitious team at the intersection of applied AI, enterprise software, and sustainability.
  • Learning budget and quarterly hackathons: Explore new technologies and prototype ideas that push Briink forward.
  • A thoughtful hiring process: We are focused on finding the right person, and are willing to take the time needed to do so.

raw.title: Senior Software Engineer
raw.description:
What's it all about?

The balance of power in the energy industry needs to change. The intermittency of renewable supply and the constant demands of the grid mean that we still rely on less efficient, more expensive and unsustainable fossil fuels to keep the lights on. At Gridfuse, our mission is to shift this balance through technology. To shift the balance of inputs, so that renewables become the world's main source of electricity.  

At Gridfuse, we develop the software that controls real renewable energy assets and turns them into a coordinated Virtual Power Plant (VPP) that can respond intelligently to energy markets and grid conditions.


Your impact

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will build the systems that connects our platform to these assets and turn energy-market and grid requirements into real-world actions. Your code will influence when batteries charge or discharge, how renewable assets respond, and how reliably these assets can participate in the electricity system. 

You will own and evolve core parts of the Control services, working closely with other software engineers and our renewable-energy experts.


The role

  • Design and build distributed control systems that coordinate fleets of batteries, wind turbines and solar plants 
  • Translate complex energy-market and grid requirements into reliable software behaviour 
  • Build the services responsible for communicating with physical assets and processing their telemetry, status and capabilities 
  • Design systems that continue to behave predictably when devices fail, networks are unreliable, messages arrive late or assets become temporarily unavailable
  • Build highly observable and resilient services that operate continuously in production
  • Take your services from architecture and implementation through deployment, monitoring and operation 
  • Work closely with energy-market specialists to understand the problem and turn it into pragmatic technical solutions 
  • Make architectural and technical decisions that balance reliability, scalability, simplicity and delivery speed 
  • Mentor other engineers and raise the technical bar across the team 


What we need from you

  • You are a self-starter who enjoys working in a fast-paced startup environment
  • You have several years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production backend systems
  • You have experience designing and architecting distributed systems
  • You have a “you build it, you run it” mindset and are familiar with Linux, Docker and Kubernetes
  • You have strong backend experience with Go or another modern programming language (We primarily use Go, but prior Go experience is not required)
  • Experience with asynchronous / event-driven systems. Experience with NATS, Kafka, RabbitMQ or MQTT is a plus
  • Solid understanding of SQL and NoSQL databases; experience with InfluxDB or Timescale is a plus
  • You communicate clearly and confidently in English


What we offer

  • Competitive hardware including a standing desk, 4K curved screen, and MacBook Pro  
  • City center office location including home office option  
  • EGYM Wellpass membership support 
  • Educational budget for every employee 
  • Team events, summer & winter parties
  • Real startup culture by having an impact in a small, motivated team   


Sounds good to you?

Please submit your complete application including your salary expectations and earliest starting date.   

After submitting an application our team will review this and get back to you within a couple of business days.

Our AI-native platform connects every person, step, and system so buying is fast, safe, and efficient – one place to request, automated approvals and renewals, real-time supplier risk, and complete spend visibility.

The opportunity is massive. Every enterprise on the planet has this problem and nobody has solved it. About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s newest unicorns with a team of just over 700 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership across a broad remit. You are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people, who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

  3. Build the best technology in-house, using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the team

Lendable is the UK market leader in real rate risk-based pricing, offering consumers transparency and product assurance at the point of application. Data Science and Analytics sits at the heart of this, developing the credit risk models and strategies to underwrite loan and credit card products.

Our team is primarily focused on the pricing domain but we also work on other areas including product and credit. We implement a range of machine learning techniques and analytical tools to continually improve our product offering.

About the role

You will be working in the UK Loans team at Lendable and will work on projects related to pricing, funnel and credit optimisation in collaboration with the credit and product teams.

Join us if you want to

  • Work in a small, high-impact team where you will be mentored to solve complex analytical problems, eventually taking ownership of your own models

  • Be resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

  • Work closely with other members of the team that will support developing your technical expertise and domain knowledge

Our team's objectives

  • The pricing team owns the loans funnel analytics and pricing strategy

  • We work across the business in a multidisciplinary capacity to identify issues, translate business problems into data questions, analyse and propose solutions

How you'll impact those objectives

  • Learn the domain of products that Lendable serves, understanding the data that informs strategy and modelling is essential to being able to successfully contribute value

  • Research and propose improvements to our existing pricing strategies and modelling methodology

  • Work closely with the credit team to align pricing decisions with credit risk and underwriting strategy

  • Clearly communicate results to stakeholders through verbal and written communication

  • Share ideas with the wider team, learn from and contribute to the body of knowledge

Key Skills

  • Experience using Python (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn) and SQL

  • Theoretical understanding of core ML techniques and statistical principles

  • Strong numerical and analytical skills, comfortable working with large datasets

  • Confident communicator and contributes effectively within a team environment

  • Self-driven and willing to take ownership of specific tasks and analyses

  • 1-2 years' experience in a technical, analytical or data-focused role

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to credit risk or financial datasets

  • Interest in Data Engineering

  • Prior experience with financial or pricing modelling

The interview process

  • A phone call with one of the team

  • Video Call case study (Remote)

  • Onsite Interview

    • Culture Interview

    • Meet the team you'll work with daily

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

title: People Partner - Content
description: About 9fin 9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion. Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets. Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption. We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide. The opportunity Our People Partners are the eyes and ears of the organisation, embedded within their functional areas to be a sounding board for leaders, support managers and enable teams to thrive. The People Partnering team operate on a strategic and tactical level, ensuring the people elements are in place for teams to effectively deliver their strategic objectives (think org design, upskilling, succession planning) whilst also offering one on one support, both structured and ad hoc, to those who need it most. We're hiring an experienced, driven Senior People Partner to partner with our Chief Content Officer and the Content (Editorial, Legals, Credit, Distressed) team. Content is scaling fast across the UK and US, and we need a Senior People Partner who can move at pace, get to grips with what the team actually does, and hold their own with senior editorial and analytical leaders. You'll be fully embedded in the Content team, with a real voice in leadership meetings, editorial rituals and off-sites. You'll know the leads, managers and rising talent well enough to catch the people issues long before they show up in engagement scores or exit interviews. Every day is different, but here's an example of the kind of things you'll work on: Strategic Trusted advisor to your leaders : You'll be the first person Content leadership calls on anything people-related: the confidant, sounding board and thought partner they think alongside, not the person they update after the fact. That kind of trust is earned over time, through showing up and being willing to have the harder conversation when it matters. Right hand person to the CCO: You know how he thinks about content and his organisation, and are confident acting as his proxy with his leaders to get them to where they need to be. Locked in on what the team is trying to achieve : You know Content's goals, what its leaders and teams do. You bring solutions, not just observations, and follow them through to completion. Fully embedded in your team : You're in the rituals, Slack channels and meetings that matter, so you've got a real read on how the team actually works. You cut through the noise to name the actual issue and get it resolved quickly and respectfully. Catching things early : You join the dots across 1:1s, skips, engagement data and your own observations to surface people risks while they're still small and easy to fix. You coach leaders and managers to build the same instinct. Org design : You advise on org shape, spot gaps and flag future risk areas. You make sure the right people are doing the right jobs at the right level as Content scales across regions and coverage. Talent management : You know who the key talent is and you work with leaders to develop, stretch and reward them. You support leaders to identify their successors and build the development plans that get them ready. You work proactively with the Talent team on the pipelines for roles you can already see coming. Learning & development : You spot where Content teams need to grow — editorial craft, analytical rigour, management skill, leadership development — and you lead the training that plugs the gap. A big part of that is upskilling managers to handle people issues themselves, early and well, rather than escalating them to the CCO. You diagnose early, source or build the right thing, and hold a bar for what impact should look like once it's landed. Reward : You use solid data to inform our salary bands and keep compensation fair across the team, with D&I front of mind. You coach leaders and managers through promotion and salary reviews so decisions are thoughtful, equitable and defensible. Performance : You help leaders and managers get the best out of their teams, surfacing blockers, coaching through them, and making sure feedback and training actually land. You hold a high bar yourself and help leaders hold one too. Hands up for the bigger stuff : You take on projects that improve the People function as a whole, not just your patch. You scope them properly, influence stakeholders, manage the risks and dependencies, and ship on time. Tactical Employee Relations (ER) : Following UK employment law, navigating all employee relations within your business area, including but not limited to: managing Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs), resolving claims and grievances in line with policy, probation management, maternity and paternity cases, flexible working requests, conflict management and mediation, and any other employee-to-employee issue that comes up, both formally and informally. Embedding people products : Working with the wider Partnering team to embed our people products and systems, delivering training, championing adoption and being the go-to person for questions. Delivering product feedback to the wider team on a regular basis. Data : Pulling and analysing the right data to help managers and leaders make good calls and adding the context that turns numbers into something your leaders can actually use. Wellbeing support : 1:1 support to employees when they need it, and making sure they know what mental and physical health support is on offer. Supporting managers through those conversations too. Cultural ambassador : Working with leaders and managers to reinforce the right behaviours in teams. Being a role model yourself for our values and ways of working, especially as the London office grows. About You This role will be a great fit if you: Take real accountability for pushing back on leaders — not just flagging a concern and moving on, but staying with it until the right decision gets made. Can confidently challenge executives and their most senior leaders when it matters, as a true partner rather than a service function. Are properly curious about the business you support. You'll want to understand how Content produces its analysis, what makes a great desk, and what separates a good journalist from a world class one. You ask questions until you get to the real answer. Are a strong influencer, able to help others look at things from different perspectives and understand the 'why' behind decisions. Comfortable pushing back on leaders and managers when needed, and know when to step back and let them make their own call. Have significant experience partnering with content, editorial, research or analyst teams and can speak their language credibly. Have a bias to action: you see what needs doing and pick it up, rather than waiting to be asked. Use data to back your decisions and see what's coming, not just to describe what's already happened. Care about data integrity and have solid experience with the day-to-day people processes and onboarding a high-trust team relies on. Have a strong grasp of UK employment law and awareness of New York employment law to reach the right, compliant call in tricky ER situations autonomously. Sharp on policies and procedures. Can context-switch frequently and comfortably hold strategic and tactical work in the same day. Are a strong team player who partners closely with your fellow People Partners, Talent Partners and the wider People and Talent team so 9finners get the best experience of us collectively. Can operate autonomously and at pace in a fast-moving scale-up. Key Requirements: 5+ years of experience in HR, preferably in fast-paced environments (tech, fintech, or start-ups) Knowledge of UK employment laws and regulations Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously Familiarity with HRIS and ATS software (we use HiBob, Lattice and Ashby) Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; ability to interact with candidates, employees, and external stakeholders in a professional and approachable manner A people-first mindset with the ability to build strong relationships and offer guidance to employees at all levels Flexible and able to thrive in a fast-moving, dynamic start-up environment Proactive and collaborative approach A genuine interest in employee well-being and fostering a supportive, inclusive culture Compensation & Benefits Finance & Insurance Competitive base salary Equity options Pension with 9fin contributing 3% (employee contributions are uncapped) Private health insurance with dental and vision Time Off 25 vacation days per year Local public holidays (with option to exchange for alternative days) Hybrid working model Work abroad for up to 3 months per year 1-month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service Enhanced parental leave and flexible working arrangements Growth & Culture Professional learning and development budget Bi-annual team socials Summer and Winter company-wide events Location: London (hybrid) 9fin is an equal opportunities employer At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognize that building diverse teams enables a more creative and productive environment. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be who we’re looking for — either for this role, or perhaps another. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
