description: An Introduction to Primer Primer is the unified infrastructure for global payments. We give finance and payments teams the visibility and control to reduce complexity, improve performance, and capture more revenue - all from a single platform. Backed by Sofina, Peak XV Partners, ICONIQ, Tencent, Accel, and Balderton, we're building the payments layer the world's best companies rely on. Watch our showcase > Read up on our $100m Series C Learn more about our culture > Which team will you be joining? You'll be joining Primer's Product Support team, reporting to our Support Lead. Support here isn't a cost centre bolted onto the side of the business — it sits inside Engineering as a full discipline, working alongside the developers who ship Primer's platform. Primer's customers are payments-technical merchants and partners, so the team spends its time in APIs, SDKs, and integration logs as much as in a ticket queue. The team runs 24/7 across Asia, Europe, and North America, and has grown to the point where one manager can no longer run it alone — which is why this role exists. You and our Support Lead will co-own Support's KPIs, metrics, and processes day-to-day. We run a deliberately low-ego, high-trust team — no dictated training plans, no micromanagement. You're joining at a genuinely interesting moment: due to the team's strong results and delivery on all our KPIs (especially Escalation Ratio and CSAT of 4.8/5), the team is about to expand into new territory as we expand the functions, partners and merchants that we support, so there's real room to shape where we go next. What will you be doing? Co-own Support's day-to-day KPIs, metrics, and processes, with direct accountability for your own group of Support Engineers. Step in when others are not available. Manage and coach a growing team of 5 Support Engineers spanning Asia, Europe, and the Americas — their delivery, growth, and performance. Drive operational excellence. Hold the team to a consistent bar on quality and pace. Perform QA, and review proposals and RFCs. Stay technically credible — dig into APIs, SDKs, and logs yourself, and step in to cover the team during periods of high demand, and on escalations. Own triage, escalation, and incident processes for your team, including leading and communicating through severe incidents and their post-mortems. Hold the team to a consistent quality and pace bar — review work, and coach rather than just monitor. Partner directly with Product and Engineering leadership to surface recurring issues, shape a realistic roadmap, and represent the voice of the customer. Identify knowledge and skill gaps across the team and facilitate the training to close them. Report on support performance and initiatives to Product & Engineering leadership, with real visibility across the company. What we're looking for Must-haves: 5+ years managing people, running a 24/7, distributed support operation — this is the one piece of experience that's essential for us Technical enough to still debug an API integration or work through logs yourself, not just manage people who do. A steady, consistent operator — someone reliable day in day out, not just on their best days. Strong written and verbal communicator, comfortable presenting to the wider company. Experience managing a major incident through to a post-mortem and RCA. Familiarity with ticketing systems like Jira, JSM, or Zendesk, and with ITSM and reporting/BI solutions. Nice-to-haves: 1-2 years in payments, or a strong B2B/SaaS background as a substitute. You may not like it here Support here isn't always exciting — you're managing people who spend their day in a ticket queue, looking at issues, troubleshooting and investigating. Time is of the essence. You'll be expected to still do the job yourself when it's busy — reviewing logs, digging into an API issue, especially on escalations or incidents — not just delegate and report up. Consistency is graded harder here than almost anywhere else. ✅ A typical interview process An initial intro call with a Talent Partner An interview with the Hiring Manager Challenge Stage - Contextualised to the role A final, values-alignment interview What's the culture like at Primer? We're building a culture where people can do their best work and be proud of the impact they have. You'll be working with people who are mission-driven, smart, and reflective, and who are genuinely invested in building exceptional products and delivering success for our merchants. We work remotely, and have done since day one. We believe that building a successful, profitable company goes beyond proximity. We invest in our relationships through great remote working practices and thoughtfully designed face-to-face time, including workations, our annual company retreat, and access to co-working spaces across most major cities. The work is challenging. Scaleups are a challenge, and building category-defining products is a challenge. But there's a meaningful difference between a challenge and a struggle. At Primer, the right challenge comes with the right support: strong onboarding, a collaborative environment, and a team that is genuinely invested in your success. It's never something you face alone. An Introduction to Primer

Primer is the unified infrastructure for global payments. We give finance and payments teams the visibility and control to reduce complexity, improve performance, and capture more revenue - all from a single platform.

Backed by Sofina, Peak XV Partners, ICONIQ, Tencent, Accel, and Balderton, we're building the payments layer the world's best companies rely on.

Watch our showcase >

Read up on our $100m Series C

Learn more about our culture >

Which team will you be joining?

You'll be joining Primer's Product Support team, reporting to our Support Lead. Support here isn't a cost centre bolted onto the side of the business — it sits inside Engineering as a full discipline, working alongside the developers who ship Primer's platform. Primer's customers are payments-technical merchants and partners, so the team spends its time in APIs, SDKs, and integration logs as much as in a ticket queue.

The team runs 24/7 across Asia, Europe, and North America, and has grown to the point where one manager can no longer run it alone — which is why this role exists. You and our Support Lead will co-own Support's KPIs, metrics, and processes day-to-day. We run a deliberately low-ego, high-trust team — no dictated training plans, no micromanagement. You're joining at a genuinely interesting moment: due to the team's strong results and delivery on all our KPIs (especially Escalation Ratio and CSAT of 4.8/5), the team is about to expand into new territory as we expand the functions, partners and merchants that we support, so there's real room to shape where we go next.

What will you be doing?

  • Co-own Support's day-to-day KPIs, metrics, and processes, with direct accountability for your own group of Support Engineers. Step in when others are not available.

  • Manage and coach a growing team of 5 Support Engineers spanning Asia, Europe, and the Americas — their delivery, growth, and performance.

  • Drive operational excellence. Hold the team to a consistent bar on quality and pace. Perform QA, and review proposals and RFCs.

  • Stay technically credible — dig into APIs, SDKs, and logs yourself, and step in to cover the team during periods of high demand, and on escalations.

  • Own triage, escalation, and incident processes for your team, including leading and communicating through severe incidents and their post-mortems.

  • Hold the team to a consistent quality and pace bar — review work, and coach rather than just monitor.

  • Partner directly with Product and Engineering leadership to surface recurring issues, shape a realistic roadmap, and represent the voice of the customer.

  • Identify knowledge and skill gaps across the team and facilitate the training to close them.

  • Report on support performance and initiatives to Product & Engineering leadership, with real visibility across the company.

What we're looking for

Must-haves:

  • 5+ years managing people, running a 24/7, distributed support operation — this is the one piece of experience that's essential for us

  • Technical enough to still debug an API integration or work through logs yourself, not just manage people who do.

  • A steady, consistent operator — someone reliable day in day out, not just on their best days.

  • Strong written and verbal communicator, comfortable presenting to the wider company.

  • Experience managing a major incident through to a post-mortem and RCA.

  • Familiarity with ticketing systems like Jira, JSM, or Zendesk, and with ITSM and reporting/BI solutions.

Nice-to-haves:

  • 1-2 years in payments, or a strong B2B/SaaS background as a substitute.

You may not like it here

  • Support here isn't always exciting — you're managing people who spend their day in a ticket queue, looking at issues, troubleshooting and investigating. Time is of the essence.

  • You'll be expected to still do the job yourself when it's busy — reviewing logs, digging into an API issue, especially on escalations or incidents — not just delegate and report up.

  • Consistency is graded harder here than almost anywhere else.

✅ A typical interview process

  • An initial intro call with a Talent Partner

  • An interview with the Hiring Manager

  • Challenge Stage - Contextualised to the role

  • A final, values-alignment interview

What's the culture like at Primer?


We're building a culture where people can do their best work and be proud of the impact they have. You'll be working with people who are mission-driven, smart, and reflective, and who are genuinely invested in building exceptional products and delivering success for our merchants.

We work remotely, and have done since day one. We believe that building a successful, profitable company goes beyond proximity. We invest in our relationships through great remote working practices and thoughtfully designed face-to-face time, including workations, our annual company retreat, and access to co-working spaces across most major cities.

The work is challenging. Scaleups are a challenge, and building category-defining products is a challenge. But there's a meaningful difference between a challenge and a struggle. At Primer, the right challenge comes with the right support: strong onboarding, a collaborative environment, and a team that is genuinely invested in your success. It's never something you face alone.

Our benefits

🌍 We are fully remote and globally distributed; and have been since day one
💰 Competitive share options
🌴 Uncapped holiday, with 25 days minimum to be taken
🗣️ Co-working space access across major cities
📅 Workations & Company Retreat
💻 The best equipment for your role
🏠 £500 towards your home office setup
🔎 Generous learning budget
🏥 Private Medical Insurance
📈 A broad set of additional perks and benefits (depending on location)

Don’t meet every single requirement?

At Primer, we're dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification listed, we encourage you to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or other roles.

Primer is committed to the equal treatment of all current and prospective employees and adopts a zero-tolerance approach to discrimination, regardless of age, disability, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race or ethnicity, religion or belief, gender identity, marriage and civil partnership, or any other background or belief.

STARK's maritime division is at the forefront of autonomous surface and subsea innovation. As Product Manager for Maritime, you own the development of STARK’s software-defined maritime capabilities and complex sensor suites. title: (Senior) Software Engineer - Data Integration Focus - Remote (m/f/d)
description: At praxipal, we are building an AI-powered healthcare admin workforce to address the global shortage of medical staff. Medical assistants are too valuable to spend their days chasing callbacks, cleaning up schedules, sending repetitive messages, or wrestling with invoicing and documentation workflows. Staff should spend time on patients. That’s why we build Luna. Our AI receptionist, Luna, answers and automates phone calls and she’s loved by hundreds of medical practitioners. Right now, we’re expanding her from calls to end-to-end patient communication across any channel. Over the next years, we’ll grow her into an AI worker that automates all administrative processes in medical practices, embedded directly into the systems practice teams already use. We’re backed by one of Europe’s leading investors and are one of the fastest growing healthtech startups in Germany. Our team has previously worked and studied at Palantir, Amazon, SAP, the University of Cambridge, and Hasso Plattner Institute. We're hiring a (Senior) Software Engineer to help us scale Luna from hundreds of medical practitioners to hundreds of thousands. The role Integration is the bottleneck and the unlock: Luna can only automate workflows when she can reliably read and write the source of truth inside a practice: schedules, patient context, messages, statuses, and workflow metadata. Over the next years, we’ll grow her into an AI worker that automates all administrative processes in medical practices, embedded directly into the systems practice teams already use.

We’re backed by one of Europe’s leading investors and are one of the fastest growing healthtech startups in Germany. Our team has previously worked and studied at Palantir, Amazon, SAP, the University of Cambridge, and Hasso Plattner Institute.

The role

Integration is the bottleneck and the unlock: Luna can only automate workflows when she can reliably read and write the source of truth inside a practice: schedules, patient context, messages, statuses, and workflow metadata. That data lives in practice management systems (PMS) and related tools.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description: V7 At V7, we’re building AI platforms that help humans do their best work, at incredible scale and speed. Our mission is to turn human knowledge into trustworthy AI, making complex tasks faster, smarter, and more accurate. We’re growing fast, backed by leading investors and AI pioneers (including the minds behind Transformers and Gemini). The product V7 Go is a platform for building and deploying custom AI agents, made for the document-heavy work finance and insurance teams handle every day. It takes multi-modal data and returns verifiable outputs with transparent logic, so accuracy and compliance come built in. It runs on the latest models too, including GPT, Claude and Gemini. Have a look at what we're building for finance and insurance . Most AI agents still behave like black boxes. They wander off-task, miss the context that matters, and make calls you can't check. Go Agents are different: predictable, transparent, and auditable at every step. Build custom AI workflows with controlled analysis at every stage. Every output comes with citations and a full audit trail, so the human in the loop can see exactly how it got there. The Context Graph makes all your data (across workflows, documents and integrations) queryable in one place, giving your agents the context to be properly useful. It's your institutional memory. The team you’ll be joining and impact you’ll have A small Platform team with a very wide remit: cloud, SRE, DevOps, developer experience, compliance, and the infrastructure behind our AI products. We run AWS first across multiple regions, with GCP and Azure alongside. Our model providers come through all three, so this is genuinely multi-cloud work. We're in the process of making everything faster, more reliable and nicer to work with, for enterprise customers who expect a lot. There are a number of compliance and big expansion projects on the horizon Our engineers lean heavily on AI coding agents and sandboxes. You’ll shape how that works across the company, giving people freedom while keeping us in control. What you’ll be doing from day one: Owning our infrastructure as code in Terraform, plus alerting, observability (Prometheus, Grafana) and reliability, including load testing and disaster recovery exercises. Making CI/CD faster (GitHub Actions, ArgoCD) and taking obstacles out of engineers’ way, from build times to how they run AI agents day to day. Running the platform behind our AI workloads across Bedrock, Vertex AI and Azure, with a close eye on reliability and cost. Getting on calls with enterprise customers and our commercial team to troubleshoot and answer infrastructure and security questions. Alongside that, compliance work and a spot on the on-call rotation. Who you are Strong AWS in production, ideally multi-region. Hands-on with GCP, with Azure a bonus. You understand how model consumption works through each cloud. Deep experience with Terraform, observability and CI/CD, and you write solid Python (Elixir is a bonus, or you’re keen to learn). A clear communicator who’s happy explaining technical things to a customer, not just to other engineers. Independent and comfortable with ambiguity. You find problems without being handed tickets, and you don’t mind when priorities flip from one week to the next. V7 champions equality and inclusion because diverse teams build better products. Don't check every box? Apply anyway — we value what makes you unique and will support you through the process, just let our Talent team know how they can help. title: Senior Business Development Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?</strong></p> <p>Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.</p></div><p><strong>Role Overview:</strong></p> <p>Reporting to the Director, Business Development, the Sr. Business Development Manager will play a key role in driving strategic partnerships and leading the commercial structuring, negotiation and execution of commercial arrangements across Studio Business Group (SBG). SBG supports PlayStation Studios’ first-party business, working across studios and teams to enable the development and delivery of world-class gaming experiences. Working within the broader business development strategy, this role will lead deals from initial evaluation and commercial structuring through negotiation, contracting, internal approvals and execution. The Sr. Business Development Manager will work closely with Legal, Finance and business stakeholders to evaluate deal economics, develop commercial terms, navigate contractual and IP considerations, and drive deals toward successful completion.</p> <p>The successful candidate will be an experienced and confident deal leader who combines strong commercial judgement with disciplined execution. They will be comfortable independently leading complex negotiations with external partners, while recognizing when strategic, financial or risk considerations require alignment or escalation to the Director and other senior stakeholders.<br><br>This role is located in the UK and you will operate as part of a global team, with primary responsibility for commercial matters in Europe and support for matters in other regions as business needs require.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Be Doing:</strong></p> <p><strong>Deal Management &amp; Negotiation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead and manage commercial negotiations and strategic deals from initial opportunity assessment through execution.</li> <li>Develop negotiation approaches and commercial structures aligned with established business and commercial objectives.</li> <li>Evaluate deal economics, key value drivers, financial implications and trade-offs to support recommendations and decision-making.</li> <li>Negotiate with external partners and identify practical solutions that balance commercial opportunity with appropriate management of risk.</li> <li>Partner with senior business development and business leaders on particularly complex, high-value or strategically significant transactions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Commercial Structuring &amp; Contracting</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop and negotiate commercial terms across a range of arrangements, including partnerships, licensing and other strategic commercial arrangements.</li> <li>Partner closely with Legal, Finance and relevant business teams to evaluate contractual, licensing, intellectual property and financial considerations.</li> <li>Translate business requirements and negotiated positions into clear commercial terms.</li> <li>Identify commercial, contractual and operational risks and work with appropriate stakeholders to develop solutions or escalation paths.</li> </ul> <p><strong>End-to-End Deal Execution</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support the commercial management of agreements throughout their lifecycle, including amendments, renewals, extensions, commercial issues and exits, working with Legal and relevant business owners as appropriate.</li> <li>Manage the deal process from initial evaluation and negotiation through contracting, approvals, execution and handoff.</li> <li>Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders throughout the deal lifecycle to maintain alignment and drive timely decision-making.</li> <li>Develop business cases, deal recommendations and materials to support internal reviews and approvals.</li> <li>Maintain clear documentation of commercial positions, approvals, commitments and key decisions.</li> <li>Contribute to the continued development of deal-management processes, tools and governance.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Stakeholder &amp; Partner Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders and serve as a knowledgeable commercial partner throughout the deal process.</li> <li>Act as a trusted commercial partner to business leaders and cross-functional stakeholders, providing advice on deal structures, commercial terms, negotiation strategy, rights and obligations, and commercial risk.</li> <li>Develop and maintain trusted relationships with external partners.</li> <li>Navigate differing priorities across internal teams and external partners to build alignment and move negotiations forward.</li> <li>Support ongoing partner relationships and identify opportunities to strengthen or expand commercial partnerships.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We Are Looking For:</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of experience in business development, deal management, commercial strategy, partnerships or a related field, with a demonstrated track record of independently leading complex commercial negotiations.</li> <li>A bachelor’s degree (or equivalent qualification or relevant professional experience) in Business, Law, Finance, or a related field.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience structuring, negotiating and executing commercial arrangements, ideally within gaming, entertainment, media, tech or other IP-led industries.</li> <li>Strong commercial acumen with the ability to assess deal economics, value drivers, financial trade-offs and business implications.</li> <li>Working knowledge of commercial contracts, licensing and intellectual property considerations, with experience partnering closely with Legal.</li> <li>Experience managing deals across the full lifecycle, including negotiation, contracting, approvals and execution.</li> <li>Strong stakeholder-management skills and experience working across complex, cross-functional organizations.</li> <li>Ability to build credible and productive relationships with external partners.</li> <li>Sound judgement and the ability to balance commercial opportunity with legal, financial and operational considerations.</li> <li>Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple deals and priorities simultaneously.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to clearly communicate commercial issues, trade-offs and recommendations.</li> <li>High standards of professionalism and integrity.</li> <li>Some domestic and international travel will be required.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p class="p1">Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which title: Professional Services - Technical Architect
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values&nbsp;and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As a Professional Services Technical Architect at GitLab, you'll lead the technical direction of customer engagements from early scoping and discovery through delivery. You'll design high-level architectures and implementation plans for GitLab infrastructure and functionality, and you'll make sure deliverables align with customer requirements and the Statement of Work (SOW). You'll coordinate and guide implementation work across GitLab Professional Services and partner consultants, support customers deploying GitLab in cloud and on-premises environments using tools like Terraform, Ansible, and the GitLab Environment Toolkit, and perform migrations to GitLab using Congregate. You'll provide DevOps and DevSecOps consulting and best practices, contribute reusable collateral such as documentation, delivery kits, and training materials, and share product release updates to help the team deliver consistent outcomes. This role combines deep technical expertise with customer-facing leadership in GitLab's remote, asynchronous, and values-driven environment.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li>Designing and delivering GitLab reference architecture implementations for both self-managed and cloud environments, using infrastructure as code practices.</li> <li>Leading source code management and CI/CD migrations to GitLab, including large-scale enterprise moves using Congregate.</li> <li>Building repeatable delivery kits, documentation, and enablement materials that help Professional Services and partners deploy and adopt GitLab best practices.</li> <li>Lead the full technical delivery lifecycle for GitLab Professional Services engagements, from early scoping and technical discovery through implementation and handoff.</li> <li>Produce high-level and detailed technical designs for GitLab infrastructure and functionality, ensuring deliverables align with customer requirements and expectations.</li> <li>Evaluate and communicate scalability and security considerations (including compliance constraints) in proposed GitLab reference architectures and implementation plans.</li> <li>Deploy and configure GitLab in customer environments, including on-premises and major cloud providers, using Terraform, Ansible, and the GitLab Environment Toolkit (GET) aligned to reference architectures.</li> <li>Plan and execute source system migrations to GitLab using Congregate, partnering closely with customer stakeholders to reduce risk, protect data integrity, and minimize downtime.</li> <li>Provide DevOps and DevSecOps consulting and best-practice guidance, including advising on internal frameworks such as the Delivery Governance Framework (DGF) and GitLab Flow.</li> <li>Coordinate and oversee implementation work across GitLab team members, partners, and customer points of contact (POCs), ensuring clear asynchronous communication and decision capture, effective execution, and high-quality outcomes.</li> <li>Mentor Professional Services and partner consultants by contributing documentation, delivery kits, and training materials, and by leading enablement sessions on how to deliver and position service offerings.</li> <li>Maintain and improve delivery automation assets with an emphasis on code cleanliness, maintainability, and appropriate unit/integration testing.</li> <li>Support scoping and Statement of Work (SOW) creation with Professional Services Engagement Managers, stay current on monthly GitLab releases, and help Regional Delivery Managers with technical vetting and staffing assessments while maintaining a 55% billable utilization.</li> <li>Review and provide input to Professional Services training materials and presentations.</li> <li>Develop case studies, presentations, design documentation, and best-practice methodologies.</li> <li>Work closely with customer project teams to ensure accurate task-level articulation of work required.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li>Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to lead technical discussions with customers and partners and communicate risks/trade-offs clearly in an asynchronous environment.</li> <li>UK remote based role.</li> <li>Up to 50% travel at times.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience delivering two or more of the following consulting services: source code management migration, cloud architecture, DevOps engineering, or continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) consulting services.</li> <li>Enterprise software development experience, with the ability to translate requirements into clear technical designs and implementation plans.</li> <li>Progressive DevOps platform experience, including designing and implementing reliable, scalable systems with clear performance and security trade-offs.</li> <li>Hands-on experience deploying and managing infrastructure in cloud providers and on-premises environments, including using tools such as Terraform and Ansible.</li> <li>Ability to write clean, maintainable automation/integration code (e.g., Terraform modules, Ansible roles, scripts) and validate changes with appropriate testing and code review.</li> <li>Experience performing migrations to GitLab, including using Congregate or similar migration tooling.</li> <li>Working knowledge of data consistency and integrity concepts (e.g., ACID properties) and how they impact migration design and performance trade-offs.</li> <li>Strong problem-solving, decision-making, organizational, and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities with minimal supervision.</li> <li>Comfort working in a remote, asynchronous environment, using documented decisions (e.g., issues, proposals, and runbooks) to keep work unblocked across time zones while collaborating effectively across GitLab team members, partners, and customer stakeholders.</li> <li>Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or other advanced technical degree, or equivalent experience.&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; #LI-CM1</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The Professional Services Technical Architect is part of GitLab's Professional Services organization. We partner with customers who are transitioning to GitLab, expanding how they use an existing GitLab installation, or planning complex upgrades to their infrastructure and processes. Our team brings a diverse set of skills across GitLab deployment, maintenance, and day-to-day usage, along with deep technical knowledge of adjacent tools and platforms. Working closely with Engagement Managers, partner consultants, and customer stakeholders, we focus on delivering high-quality outcomes, sharing best practices, and helping customers realize faster time to value from their GitLab investment. We operate in GitLab's remote, asynchronous environment and rely on clear documentation and transparent communication to collaborate effectively.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>This role models skills and behaviour aligned with GitLab Values and typically reports to the Regional Delivery Manager. As a Professional Services Technical Architect, you will work more independently than an associate consultant, leveraging deep technical expertise to drive customer outcomes.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off&nbsp;</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation &amp; Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a>&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. raw.title: Senior Lead, Government Innovation and Economic Growth
raw.description:
The Role's Purpose

Plexal operates at the intersection of government, industry and emerging technology, helping organisations turn innovation ambition into practical capability, adoption and measurable impact.
 
The Senior Lead, Government Innovation & Economic Growth will play a critical role in shaping and delivering Plexal's growth across government. This is a nationally focused role responsible for identifying, shaping and securing high-value opportunities across central government, public sector organisations and strategic partners.
 
Based in the North West, the role will help position Plexal at the forefront of the UK's evolving government and innovation landscape. As government influence, investment and decision-making become increasingly distributed beyond Whitehall, the role will help Plexal identify and capitalise on emerging opportunities across government, economic growth, public sector reform, innovation adoption and place-based investment.
 
The successful candidate will combine strong commercial leadership with deep government insight, helping Plexal understand where policy, funding and customer priorities are moving and translating those trends into strategic opportunities, partnerships and sustainable revenue growth.
 
This is a hands-on commercial leadership role combining business development, strategic relationship management, proposition development and opportunity leadership, while also acting as a senior advisor to the wider GTM and leadership teams.


What You'll Do

  • Government Growth & Opportunity Leadership
    • Identify, prioritise and lead the pursuit of high-value opportunities across UK government. 
    • Build and maintain senior relationships across government departments, agencies, arm's-length bodies and wider public sector organisations. 
    • Shape early-stage opportunities by aligning customer priorities, policy developments and commercial propositions. 
    • Lead complex multi-stakeholder pursuits from early engagement through to contract award. 
    • Navigate government procurement and commercial environments, ensuring Plexal is well positioned to maximise success. 
    • Develop and maintain a strong understanding of government priorities, funding mechanisms and investment strategies to identify future opportunities ahead of formal procurement.
  • Market Intelligence & Strategic Positioning
    • Develop deep insight into emerging government priorities including economic growth, innovation adoption, AI, cyber resilience, public sector reform, science and technology, and place-based investment. 
    • Translate policy, market and customer insight into actionable growth opportunities for Plexal. 
    • Help shape Plexal's understanding of where government priorities, investment and demand are evolving. 
    • Identify emerging markets, funding streams and policy-driven opportunities that align with Plexal's strategic objectives. 
    • Position Plexal as a trusted partner capable of helping government translate ambition into adoption and measurable impact.
  • Cross-Government Go-To-Market Leadership
    • Shape and co-own Plexal's cross-government go-to-market strategy. 
    • Identify priority growth areas, departments and opportunity themes aligned to Plexal's strengths. 
    • Support the development and refinement of propositions that respond to changing government needs. 
    • Build repeatable approaches to opportunity identification, qualification and pursuit. 
    • Strengthen commercial discipline and opportunity management across the organisation. 
    • Support the creation of scalable propositions that can be applied across multiple government customers and sectors.
  • Strategic Relationship Management & Ecosystem Development
    • Act as a senior external representative for Plexal across government, industry and innovation ecosystem engagements. 
    • Build trusted relationships with senior government leaders, policy makers, commercial stakeholders and delivery partners. 
    • Establish Plexal as a credible voice within conversations around innovation, technology adoption, economic growth and government transformation. 
    • Build relationships across emerging government and innovation ecosystems outside London as government investment and decision-making continues to evolve. 
    • Represent Plexal at senior meetings, industry forums, conferences and government-facing events.
  • Partnerships & Growth Enablement
    • Develop strategic relationships with consultancies, technology providers, universities, ecosystem partners and delivery organisations. 
    • Build and shape consortium opportunities where partner-led approaches strengthen Plexal's position. 
    • Support priority bids, negotiations and commercial pursuits across the wider organisation. 
    • Share best practice across government sales, account development and opportunity shaping. 
    • Mentor and support colleagues across the commercial and delivery teams to strengthen capability and confidence.
  • KPIs and Commercial Outcomes
    • Significant £m pipeline generated and influenced across government markets. 
    • Material revenue secured through direct and partner-led opportunities. 
    • Number and quality of strategic opportunities shaped prior to procurement. 
    • Growth in multi-year and repeatable revenue opportunities. 
    • Conversion rate improvement across priority pursuits. 
    • Growth in partner-led opportunities and consortium wins. 
    • Strength and depth of senior relationships across government and strategic partners.
    • Contribution to Plexal's long-term positioning across government innovation, adoption and economic growth markets.


Your Skills

  • Commercially driven, outcome-focused and highly proactive. 
  • Naturally curious about government priorities, policy developments and market trends. 
  • Highly credible operating at senior levels across government and industry. 
  • Strong relationship builder with the ability to influence and align diverse stakeholder groups. 
  • Strategic thinker capable of translating insight into action. 
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and shaping undefined opportunities. 
  • Collaborative and committed to enabling the success of others. 
  • Resilient, adaptable and able to thrive in fast-moving environments.


Your Experience

Essential:

  • Proven track record of selling into UK government and winning complex public sector opportunities. 
  • Demonstrable success securing and growing contracts valued at £1m+ and/or multi-year engagements. 
  • Strong understanding of government procurement, commercial processes and public sector buying environments. 
  • Experience building relationships with senior government stakeholders. 
  • Strong commercial acumen including opportunity shaping, negotiation and deal strategy. 
  • Experience developing and executing go-to-market strategies in complex environments. 
  • Experience working with partners to shape and deliver consortium bids and strategic opportunities. 
  • Ability to operate effectively across strategy, relationship management and hands-on opportunity delivery. 
  • Strong understanding of the relationship between government policy, funding, investment priorities and commercial opportunity.
 
Highly desirable:
  • Experience working across multiple government departments or policy domains. 
  • Understanding of economic growth, devolution, place-based investment and public sector reform. 
  • Experience within innovation, technology, consulting, digital transformation, cyber or AI-related environments. 
  • Experience identifying and developing opportunities arising from policy change, government reform and market shifts. 
  • Existing network across UK government, strategic partners and innovation ecosystems. 
  • Experience operating within high-growth, entrepreneurial or scaling organisations. 
  • Familiarity with government priorities relating to AI adoption, cyber resilience, science and technology, productivity and economic growth.


Who You Are

  • Willingness to undertake regular national travel (>40%) and occasional international travel
  • Open to UK Nationals who hold or are eligible for Security Check (SC) clearance. (See more on clearance eligibility.)
  • Degree-level education or equivalent professional experience
  • Relevant commercial, consulting or public sector credentials are advantageous
  • Commitment to Plexal’s values of diversity, equity, and inclusion


Why us?

As a start-up, we thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced work environment dedicated to empowering innovators. We embrace individuals who leverage technology and creativity to tackle our greatest challenges head-on. We strongly advocate for maintaining a harmonious work-life balance, our goal is to ensure every member of our team can authentically be themselves and live their best lives. We firmly believe that innovation and creativity flourish when we cultivate a diverse workforce, comprising highly skilled individuals with a wide range of perspectives to contribute.
 
In return we will offer you:

  • Salary: £80,000 - £100,000 depending on skills and experience
  • Annual bonus scheme
  • A generous pension scheme (with a company contribution of up to 10%)
  • Private healthcare, life assurance and critical illness cover
  • 25 days holiday plus bank holidays
  • Volunteering day

You’ll have strong product judgement, care deeply about craft and know how to make complicated things feel simple. raw.title: Solutions and Implementation Manager
raw.description:
About SINGU

At SINGU, we’re redefining how the world’s most ambitious real estate companies run their operations. Our mission is to become Europe’s leading platform for managing warehouse, logistics, retail, and multi-site commercial real estate portfolios — empowering our Clients to protect revenue, boost efficiency, and unlock new value across every aspect of their business.

 

Our unified CAFM platform already powers the daily operations of over 250 million m² of real estate worldwide, supporting more than 500,000 professionals. Following our union with the UK’s Micad and Germany’s net-haus, we now help manage 100,000+ buildings across 35+ countries — and we’re just getting started.

 

Backed by a leading growth equity investor, we’re scaling rapidly and partnering with global leaders such as Prologis, ECE, CTP, Hillwood, Logicor, GLP, and Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield. As we continue to grow through strategic acquisitions and bold innovation, we stay true to our core values: adaptability, collaboration, and client focus.

 

If you’re ready to help build Europe’s leading platform for property operations — and make a tangible impact on how the real estate industry works — join SINGU and be part of this transformation.

About The Role

We're looking for a Solutions and Implementation Manager to join our Customer Experience team, managing the delivery and implementation of Micad FM, our estates management platform, for our UK customer base. We're bolstering the team ahead of a high volume of upcoming implementations.

In this role, you'll be the technical expert who bridges the gap between sales and Customer Success – owning the customer journey from pre-sales through to complete implementation. If you're excited about managing complex technical projects, solving implementation challenges, and being the linchpin between our commercial and delivery teams, this is the opportunity for you!

Where will you be based? This role is remote within the UK, and the Cardiff area is our preference. If you're near Cardiff, we'd ask you to co-locate with the team around once a week; if you're based elsewhere in the UK, we bring the team together in person roughly once a quarter.

Our projects can be delivered remotely, but we travel to client sites where it's beneficial for the customer — expect an average of about one trip a month, so you'll need to be open to travel.

What you'll be doing

  • Lead customer onboarding and implementation – own the technical deployment of Micad FM for UK customers, configuring solutions to meet their specific requirements, delivering training, and ensuring successful go-live.

  • Act as a technical advisor and product expert – develop deep knowledge of Micad FM to guide customers through complex configurations, troubleshoot technical issues, demonstrate ROI, and identify opportunities to expand usage across their organisation.

  • Drive revenue growth and expansion – lead technical product discovery and demonstrations with Sales to scope additional modules, integrations, and services that deliver value.

  • Conduct strategic Success Planning – lead Success planning sessions with key accounts, demonstrating measurable outcomes and ensuring alignment between customer objectives and our solutions.

  • Work cross-functionally – partner with Sales, Customer Success, Product and Engineering to deliver a joined-up customer experience, provide product feedback, and advocate for customer needs internally.

  • Build the team and the playbook – work with our implementation lead to develop repeatable delivery processes, mentor colleagues, and help shape a high-performing implementation function as we scale.

What We're Looking For

  • Technical implementation experience – you have a proven track record in implementation, technical account management, or solutions consulting roles (ideally in SaaS, PropTech, CAFM, or B2B software), with the ability to configure and deploy software solutions.

  • Sales acumen and commercial awareness – you understand the customer lifecycle, can articulate ROI, and work collaboratively with sales teams to drive revenue growth.

  • Strong technical aptitude – you're comfortable learning complex software platforms, troubleshooting issues, and training end-users on best practices.

  • Excellent communicator and relationship builder – you can translate technical concepts into business value, build trust with stakeholders at all levels, and navigate complex organisational dynamics.

  • Data-driven and technically proficient – you're comfortable with CRM software (e.g., HubSpot, Zoho), project management tools (e.g., Jira), and analysing customer data to drive decisions and demonstrate value.

What Success looks like in this role

You'll be measured on implementation completion rates, time to value, and the quality of technical engagement that moves deals to closed won.

Who you'll be working with and reporting to

You'll report to our Solutions and Implementation Team Lead and work closely with our Sales, Product, and Customer Success teams across SINGU. Our teams are highly collaborative and dedicated to delivering exceptional customer experiences and growth.

 

Why join SINGU?

  • Permanent contract with a competitive yearly salary, based on your experience.

  • A collaborative, no-micromanagement culture — we trust you to deliver.

  • Part of a fast-scaling, international group redefining how real estate is managed.

  • Private equity-backed and a year into a three-to-five-year investment horizon — fast-paced, target-driven, with the budget and autonomy already in place to deliver.

  • Genuine scope to put your mark here — as the team scales, you'll help shape how we deliver and progress quickly with it.

  • Real ownership from day one — you'll lead technical implementations end to end, from sale through to successful go-live.

  • A pivotal moment to join — we're taking service delivery to the next level and looking for people ready to get stuck in and make a real impact.

If this role sounds like a good fit, we’d love to hear from you. Apply and help us build technology that supports critical operations every day.

title: Senior Product Manager, Data Infrastructure
description: For over 30 years, Angi has powered the future of the home services industry, creating an environment where homeowners and pros benefit from more jobs done well. For homeowners, our platform is a reliable way to find skilled pros. For pros, we're a reliable business partner who helps them find the winnable work they want, when they want. For employees, we're an amazing place to call home. We can't wait to welcome you. Angi at a glance: Founded in 1995 as Angie’s List and rebranded in 2021 Global company with 9 brands in 8 countries and employees worldwide Homeowners have turned to us for 300 million home projects and counting About the Team Data Infrastructure builds the platform that every other data team stands on: access to shared data, orchestration, data ingestion, and the retirement of systems the company has outgrown. Every layer of this platform exists to make it easier for a homeowner to hire an Angi Pro, on one certified source of truth that people and AI agents can trust equally. The team's strategy is built around one idea: this platform should feel like a self-service product, not a ticket queue, for the engineers and analysts who depend on it, and increasingly for the AI agents who depend on it too. Angi is moving toward AI agents as a normal way of building and operating, and every agent that touches company data comes through this platform first. This role stewards that platform's product direction. What You'll Do Product Management Manage governed platform access - give engineers, analysts, and services safe, auditable access to shared data, and make the safe path the easy path. Streamline orchestration and scheduling - bring fragmented scheduling tools together into one system every team reaches for by default, and use AI-assisted tooling to migrate jobs faster, with less manual engineering effort. Drive data ingestion and replication - define what self-service ingestion looks like for teams who want to bring their own data onto the platform, and build toward that. Oversee legacy system retirement - close out systems that are no longer the source of truth, with clear ownership handed off at every step. Optimize compute cost efficiency - find where cost comes from habit rather than real need, and bring it down without anyone losing the developer experience they rely on. Advance compute strategy diversification - help move the platform toward a storage layer that works with more than one compute engine, so each workload runs on the engine built for it. Build the platform's AI-ready substrate - make agentic workflows safe by default, with the same governed access and audit trail for an agent as for a person. Execution and Individual Contribution Use AI agents in your own daily work, set clear norms so the engineers and peers around you feel safe experimenting with agents and agentic workflows. Protect the team's focus and drive real rigor without micromanaging how the work gets done. Steward outcomes, not tasks. Build trust across engineering, domain teams, and leadership through empathetic, transparent, and clear communication when addressing complex challenges. Work closely with Data Engineering's other delivery teams - Data Mesh Enablement and Managed Data Products - and with the team building Angi's agentic workflows, toward one overall technical strategy. Who You Are Five or more years of product management experience on a data or infrastructure platform team, where you stewarded technical roadmaps directly. Comfortable reading system architecture and pipeline dependencies well enough to make real sequencing calls with engineering. A record of taking cross-team migrations and retirements all the way to done, not just to a plan. Transparent about areas of growth and open to learning, rather than presenting incomplete information as fully resolved under pressure. Preferred Qualifications Experience weighing compute cost against performance and developer experience, and driving that tradeoff to a decision rather than just planning around it. Working knowledge of how AI agents consume data and tools differently from people, and judgment on when a vendor's own agent layer already covers a need. A proactive approach to navigating and understanding new technical systems, key contacts, and open questions independently. Compensation & Benefits The salary band for this position ranges from €90,000 - 120,000, commensurate with experience and qualifications. Hybrid work environment and home office set-up allowance. Temporary work from abroad policy. Regular team and social events. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Veepee a réalisé en 2024 un chiffre d’affaires de 3,3 milliards d’euros TTC et compte 5 000 collaborateurs répartis dans 10 pays. 📄 DESCRIPTION DU POSTE Au cœur de la Supply Chain et de l'unité Food & Beverage basée à Beaune, le Déclarant en douane et conseil (Alternance) assure la conformité réglementaire de nos flux de marchandises, notamment pour les vins, spiritueux et épicerie fine.  En collaboration étroite avec la Coordinatrice comptabilité matière, il participe activement à l'amélioration continue de nos processus et outils douaniers, jouant un rôle clé dans la sécurisation opérationnelle et le développement international.  Ce poste stratégique se situe à l'intersection de l'administration douanière, de l'opérationnel logistique et de l'analyse, nécessitant un profil rigoureux, organisé et doté d'une forte appétence pour l'univers du transport et des réglementations Le titulaire gère en autonomie les déclarations douanières, le suivi de stock de comptabilité matière (droits d'accises, DAE) et la conformité fiscale des produits. Maîtrise de Google Sheets (extraction, tableaux). Appréhension du logiciel Gamma (outil de déclaration). raw.description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information, visit www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

 

The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our Connect team, reporting to Rémi Fouilloux, Senior Engineering Manager. The team is split between Bordeaux and Paris.

Together, you'll be building and scaling Mirakl Connect, an innovative solution that simplifies sellers' daily lives through a central hub powered by the latest advances in AI.

Location: Based in Paris or Bordeaux office with one day of remote work per week.

Your Impact

  • Drive technical excellence: Take ownership of user stories, conduct code reviews, and actively contribute to design, development, testing, and production deployments
  • Coordinate cross-functional delivery: Develop roadmaps with R&D, align priorities with other tech leads, and partner with product and design teams to deliver on commitments with high velocity and quality
  • Develop talent and best practices: Ensure successful onboarding, identify and nurture team talent, contribute to recruitment, and establish best practices in clean code, testing, and pair programming
  • Remove blockers and enable success: Step in to resolve technical challenges, make arbitration decisions, and ensure the team delivers on its commitments
  • Lead and grow your team: Manage and mentor 4-5 developers, conducting one-on-ones, performance reviews, and fostering team cohesion and motivation across distributed locations
  • Participate in the adoption of AI : within our products but also in internal practices 

What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:

  • At least 5 years of Java development experience with recent versions
  • Minimum 2 years in a team lead or similar management role, mentoring developers
  • Proven ability to balance hands-on technical contribution with people management
  • Track record of delivering complex projects in a microservices environment
  • Professional proficiency in English 

Skills:

  • Java development and architecture
  • Team leadership and mentoring
  • Technical decision-making and problem-solving
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Clean code and engineering best practices

Tech Stack

  • Java (recent versions)
  • Spring Framework
  • SQL
  • Cloud platforms
  • Microservices architecture

 

Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.

Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application. This helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.

Interview steps:

  1. 30/45-minute call with someone from the recruitment team to discuss your key projects, ask technical questions, and present the position in details
  2. 45-minute technical interview on Google Meet with an experienced developer to discuss our technical stack and assess your knowledge
  3. 1-hour business discussion with the Senior Engineering Manager 
  4. 2 x 45-minute STAR interviews to assess your alignment with our values and meet other stakeholders 

More information about our recruitment philosophy 👉 3 tips to shine in STAR interviews at Mirakl

 

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. Accueillir et enthousiasmer les clientes en les abordant dès leur entrée dans l’espace dédié. Fournir des conseils personnalisés en lingerie en cabine d’essayage pour chaque cliente. Mettre en valeur les produits en assurant la présentation soignée du stand et en veillant à ce que l’espace de vente soit toujours impeccable et accueillant. Informer les clientes sur les produits, leurs caractéristiques et avantages, tout en partageant l’histoire et les valeurs de nos marques. Vous possédez une expérience préalable dans la vente, idéalement dans le secteur de la lingerie. Vous êtes doté(e) d'une excellente présentation et d’un sens aigu du service client, avec une capacité à écouter, comprendre et conseiller efficacement. Vous êtes dynamique, autonome et à l'aise dans un environnement de vente exigeant. Vous avez une énergie positive et détectez toujours des opportunités pour mettre davantage en avant nos marques sur la surface de vente. Vous avez une bonne connaissance des tendances et êtes à l’aise avec l’évolution des attentes de la clientèle. Vous avez une forte orientation résultats et êtes motivé(e) à atteindre et dépasser les objectifs commerciaux. Notre Offre: Un contrat d’apprentissage.   Un environnement de travail autonome (shop-in-shop) avec un encadrement et un soutien personnel adaptés.  Une formation complète en lingerie styling et en connaissance produit des marques dont vous pourrez être fier(ère).  Une rémunération attractive, avec une prime trimestrielle liée à vos performances.  Un planning respectueux de votre équilibre vie professionnelle-vie personnelle.  Postulez dès maintenant pour rejoindre notre équipe et faire rayonner l’univers de PrimaDonna et Sarda dans l’un des magasins les plus prestigieux de Lyon. ·       Configurer, tester et mettre en production les solutions, en assurant leur fiabilité

Accompagner l’adoption et décentraliser les capacités

·       Créer la documentation, les guides et les bonnes pratiques pour rendre l’autonomie possible

·       Tester et évaluer de nouvelles briques technologiques pour enrichir la plateforme

Ce que nous offrons :  

·       Un rôle à fort impact au cœur de la stratégie IA d’un cabinet en croissance de ~20 % par an

·       L’accès direct à Dust, aux API des principaux LLM du marché, et à une plateforme de création d’applications

·       Une exposition unique aux métiers du conseil financier et opérationnel (transactions, restructurations, transformations)

·       Un mentorat par des profils seniors tech et consulting

·       Un environnement entrepreneurial, exigeant et bienveillant

·       Des bureaux à Paris et la possibilité de collaborer avec les équipes européennes du groupe


Le profil recherché: 

Formation :

·       Bac+4/5 en cours (école d’ingénieurs, master informatique, data science ou équivalent)

Ce poste est fait pour quelqu’un qui vit l’IA au quotidien. Pas comme un sujet académique, mais comme un outil qu’il utilise, teste, détourne et pousse dans ses retranchements. Tu suis les sorties de modèles, tu expérimentes avec les API, tu as déjà construit des choses avec des LLM — même imparfaites. La curiosité et l’enthousiasme pour l’IA sont absolument indispensables.

Compétences techniques :

·       Expérience concrète ou projets personnels avec les LLM, le prompt engineering, les agents IA

·       Capacité à prototyper vite et à itérer en conditions réelles

·       Python (prioritaire) ; JavaScript/TypeScript apprécié

·       Familiarité avec les API REST, les bases de données (SQL), les environnements cloud

·       Anglais courant

Qualités personnelles :

·       Débrouillardise et biais pour l’action : tu préfères livrer un prototype imparfait aujourd’hui plutôt qu’un plan parfait dans trois mois

·       Aisance relationnelle et pédagogie : tu sais parler à des consultants qui ne sont pas développeurs

·       Rigueur et autonomie : tu gères plusieurs projets en parallèle et tu sais prioriser

description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Algolia, we’re proud to be a pioneer and market leader in AI Search, empowering 18,000+ businesses to deliver blazing-fast, predictive search and browse experiences at internet scale. title: Post-doctorat en interprétabilité mécaniste et diversité des représentations
description: Grande école d’ingénieur généraliste de l’IMT-Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs de France, IMT Atlantique a pour ambition d’accompagner les transitions, de former des ingénieurs responsables et mettre l'excellence scientifique et technique au service de l'enseignement, de la recherche et de l'innovation. Le poste est basé à Brest, au sein de l'équipe BRAIN (BRoader Artificial INtelligence) du Lab-STICC (UMR CNRS 6285). L'équipe travaille sur les fondements de l'apprentissage automatique (représentations, apprentissage frugal, modèles de fondation, traitement du signal) et sur leurs applications, en particulier en santé. Elle a récemment développé REVE, un modèle de fondation pour l'électroencéphalographie pré-entraîné sur plus de 25 000 sujets (NeurIPS 2025), et s’intéresse aux modèles de langage à diffusion discrète et sur l'interprétabilité mécaniste. Le projet ENDIVE étudie ce que la diversité peut apporter à l'apprentissage automatique lorsque le budget porte sur le nombre d'exemples annotés plutôt que sur la puissance de calcul. Dans ce régime, ce qu'apporte un nouvel exemple ne dépend plus seulement de sa qualité propre, mais de ce qui le distingue de ceux déjà vus. Le point d'entrée technique du projet est l'échantillonnage à garanties de diversité, et en particulier les processus ponctuels déterminantaux (DPP), dont la matrice de noyau encode à la fois la pertinence des points et leur similarité. Le projet explore cette question sur deux plans complémentaires : la diversité des données, soit le choix des exemples que l'on annote, conserve ou présente au modèle ; et la diversité des représentations, soit le choix des descripteurs, des contextes et des modèles que l'on exploite ou combine. Les premiers résultats portent sur le décodage diversifié des modèles de langue à diffusion discrète et sur la localisation de l'information dans les représentations des transformers. Le poste proposé porte sur le second plan, abordé par les outils de l'interprétabilité mécaniste. Page du projet : https://bastienpasdeloup.github.io/endive/ MISSIONS Les missions principales du poste sont les suivantes : Définir et évaluer des critères de diversité dans l'espace des représentations des modèles de fondation, en s'appuyant sur les outils de l'interprétabilité mécaniste. 2. Étudier le lien entre la diversité des données d'entraînement et la diversité des mécanismes internes que les modèles acquièrent. 3. Contribuer à la production et à la diffusion scientifiques du projet. ACTIVITÉS : Critères de diversité dans les représentations : • Entraîner et analyser des autoencodeurs parcimonieux sur les activations de modèles de fondation, afin d'en extraire des descripteurs interprétables. • Construire des noyaux de similarité entre ces descripteurs et évaluer, au moyen de processus ponctuels déterminantaux, si un sous-ensemble divers en fournit une couverture plus compacte que la seule importance individuelle. • Mesurer l'effet de ces critères sur des tâches aval en régime peu annoté, et comparer les profondeurs du réseau auxquelles les représentations sont lues. 2. Diversité des données et diversité des mécanismes : • Comparer les descripteurs retrouvés par des autoencodeurs parcimonieux entraînés sur des modèles nourris de régimes de données différents, et quantifier leur recouvrement. • Évaluer la stabilité de ces descripteurs d'un entraînement à l'autre, afin de distinguer les mécanismes reproductibles des artefacts d'optimisation. • Mettre ces mesures en relation avec les procédures de curation étudiées dans le projet, en particulier pour les modèles de langage à diffusion discrète. 3. Production scientifique et vie du projet : • Rédiger et soumettre les résultats obtenus dans des conférences et revues internationales. • Publie le code et les protocoles expérimentaux nécessaires à la reproductibilité des résultats. raw.title: Post-doctorat en interprétabilité mécaniste et diversité des représentations
raw.description:
Grande école d’ingénieur généraliste de l’IMT-Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs de France, IMT Atlantique a pour ambition d’accompagner les transitions, de former des ingénieurs responsables et mettre l'excellence scientifique et technique au service de l'enseignement, de la recherche et de l'innovation.

Le poste est basé à Brest, au sein de l'équipe BRAIN (BRoader Artificial INtelligence) du Lab-STICC (UMR CNRS 6285). L'équipe travaille sur les fondements de l'apprentissage automatique (représentations, apprentissage frugal, modèles de fondation, traitement du signal) et sur leurs applications, en particulier en santé. Elle a récemment développé REVE, un modèle de fondation pour l'électroencéphalographie pré-entraîné sur plus de 25 000 sujets (NeurIPS 2025), et s’intéresse aux modèles de langage à diffusion discrète et sur l'interprétabilité mécaniste.

Le projet ENDIVE étudie ce que la diversité peut apporter à l'apprentissage automatique lorsque le budget porte sur le nombre d'exemples annotés plutôt que sur la puissance de calcul. Dans ce régime, ce qu'apporte un nouvel exemple ne dépend plus seulement de sa qualité propre, mais de ce qui le distingue de ceux déjà vus. Le point d'entrée technique du projet est l'échantillonnage à garanties de diversité, et en particulier les processus ponctuels déterminantaux (DPP), dont la matrice de noyau encode à la fois la pertinence des points et leur similarité.

Le projet explore cette question sur deux plans complémentaires : la diversité des données, soit le choix des exemples que l'on annote, conserve ou présente au modèle ; et la diversité des représentations, soit le choix des descripteurs, des contextes et des modèles que l'on exploite ou

combine. Les premiers résultats portent sur le décodage diversifié des modèles de langue à diffusion discrète et sur la localisation de l'information dans les représentations des transformers.

Le poste proposé porte sur le second plan, abordé par les outils de l'interprétabilité mécaniste. Page du

projet : https://bastienpasdeloup.github.io/endive/

MISSIONS

Les missions principales du poste sont les suivantes :

  1. Définir et évaluer des critères de diversité dans l'espace des représentations des modèles de

fondation, en s'appuyant sur les outils de l'interprétabilité mécaniste.

2. Étudier le lien entre la diversité des données d'entraînement et la diversité des mécanismes internes

que les modèles acquièrent.

3. Contribuer à la production et à la diffusion scientifiques du projet.

ACTIVITÉS :

  1. Critères de diversité dans les représentations :

• Entraîner et analyser des autoencodeurs parcimonieux sur les activations de modèles de

fondation, afin d'en extraire des descripteurs interprétables.

• Construire des noyaux de similarité entre ces descripteurs et évaluer, au moyen de processus

ponctuels déterminantaux, si un sous-ensemble divers en fournit une couverture plus

compacte que la seule importance individuelle.

• Mesurer l'effet de ces critères sur des tâches aval en régime peu annoté, et comparer les

profondeurs du réseau auxquelles les représentations sont lues.

2. Diversité des données et diversité des mécanismes :

• Comparer les descripteurs retrouvés par des autoencodeurs parcimonieux entraînés sur des

modèles nourris de régimes de données différents, et quantifier leur recouvrement.

• Évaluer la stabilité de ces descripteurs d'un entraînement à l'autre, afin de distinguer les

mécanismes reproductibles des artefacts d'optimisation.

• Mettre ces mesures en relation avec les procédures de curation étudiées dans le projet, en

particulier pour les modèles de langage à diffusion discrète.

3. Production scientifique et vie du projet :

• Rédiger et soumettre les résultats obtenus dans des conférences et revues internationales.

• Publie le code et les protocoles expérimentaux nécessaires à la reproductibilité des résultats.


Niveau de formation et/ou expérience minimums requis :

🎓 Doctorat obtenu moins de 3 ans avant la date d'embauche, en apprentissage automatique, informatique, traitement du signal ou mathématiques appliquées.

Compétences, connaissances et expériences indispensables :

✔️ Solide maîtrise de l'apprentissage profond et de ses fondements mathématiques.

✔️ Pratique courante de Python et d'un cadre d'apprentissage profond, PyTorch de préférence.

✔️ Expérience de travail sur des architectures de type transformer, et capacité à instrumenter leurs représentations internes.

✔️ Autonomie dans la conduite d'expériences sur GPU, y compris sur une infrastructure de calcul partagée.

🇬🇧 Publications dans des conférences ou revues internationales du domaine, et très bon niveau d'anglais scientifique, écrit comme oral.

Compétences, connaissances et expériences souhaitables :

✨ Connaissance de l'interprétabilité mécaniste : autoencodeurs parcimonieux, sondes linéaires, analyse de circuits.

✨ Familiarité avec les processus ponctuels déterminantaux, ou plus généralement avec les méthodes d'échantillonnage et l'algèbre linéaire aléatoire.

✨ Intérêt pour les modèles de langage à diffusion discrète.

✨ Expérience du calcul distribué multi-GPU et d'un ordonnanceur de type SLURM.

Capacités et aptitudes :

✔️ Autonomie scientifique et goût pour les questions ouvertes, le poste comportant une part exploratoire assumée.

✔️ Rigueur expérimentale et attention portée à la reproductibilité.

✔️ Goût du travail collectif : le poste est en interaction directe avec plusieurs doctorants du projet.
